metadata.title: Setup Zuper Pay > Surcharge Settings

text:
Surcharge Fee
> Pass credit card processing fees to customers

Every credit card payment comes with a processing fee, which is typically absorbed by your business. The **Surcharge Fee Pass-Through** feature in Zuper allows you to pass that fee on to the customer instead.

Configure your surcharge rate once in Settings, and Zuper automatically applies the surcharge to eligible credit card payments for invoices and quote deposits. At checkout, Zuper calculates the surcharge amount and displays it as a separate line item so customers can see the additional charge before completing their payment. If needed, you can disable the surcharge for an individual invoice or quote without affecting other transactions.

Zuper has partnered with **Yeeld**, a surcharge compliance service, to ensure surcharges are calculated accurately and applied in accordance with card brand rules and state regulations.

Note:
  This feature is available for payments processed through **Zuper Pay** only.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee

text:
Surcharge Fee > Before You Begin
* Your account is enabled for **Zuper Pay.**
* You have **Admin** permissions to access Surcharge Settings.
* You have reviewed the [Prohibited States](#prohibited-states) section below. Surcharging is not allowed in every U.S. state. Check with your legal team before enabling this feature.
* Surcharges apply to **credit card payments** only. Debit and prepaid cards are not eligible.
* The surcharge you configure does not exceed the lower of **3%** or your total average cost of credit card acceptance.

Check:
  **Important**: The ZIP code in the customer's or organization's billing address, the card information, and your business's operating state are all used to determine surcharge eligibility and the applicable rate. Confirm these are entered accurately before processing a payment.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > Before You Begin

text:
Surcharge Fee > How your surcharge rate is determined
Zuper does not always apply the surcharge rate you configure. For each credit card transaction, Zuper compares the following rates and applies the lower one:

* The surcharge rate you configured for the [transaction amount](/Zuper-pay/Surcharge#setting-up-surcharge-rules).
* The maximum surcharge rate permitted by Yeeld's compliance service for the card and billing location.

To determine the permitted rate, Zuper sends the card type, your business's operating state, and the customer's billing ZIP code to Yeeld. Yeeld then returns whether a surcharge can be applied and, if so, the maximum surcharge rate allowed for that transaction.

As a result, the surcharge applied to a transaction may be lower than your configured rate and may not fully offset your actual credit card processing costs.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > How your surcharge rate is determined

text:
Surcharge Fee > Setting up Surcharge Rules
Start by setting up your surcharge rules in Settings. This is a one-time configuration that tells Zuper how much to charge based on the invoice or quote total. You can define tiered ranges so smaller invoices carry a lower fee than larger ones.

1. Navigate to the **Settings** module from the left navigation menu.
2. Select **Zuper Pay.**
3. Select **Surcharge Settings.**

4. Toggle **Enable Surcharge Fee** to **On.** This is the organization-wide setting. Once it's on, surcharging is enabled by default on every invoice and quote deposit. See "**Turning off the surcharge for one invoice or quote**" below to override this on a single transaction.
5. Read and accept the consent form to activate the feature.
6. In the **Select a State** field, choose the state of your business operation.

Warning:
  **Warning**: Some states prohibit or restrict credit card surcharging.

7. Under **Define Surcharge Fee Range**, set up your tiers:
   1. Enter the **Minimum Amount.**
   2. Enter the **Maximum Amount.**
   3. Enter the **Surcharge Percentage** for that range.
   4. Click **+ Add New Range** to add additional tiers and repeat.

8. Click **Save.**

Warning:
  **Warning**: If a transaction total falls outside your configured ranges, no surcharge will be applied even if the feature is enabled. Ensure your tiers cover the invoice and quote amounts you expect to process.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > Setting up Surcharge Rules

text:
Surcharge Fee > Turning off the surcharge for one invoice or quote
Once you turn on the organization-level setting above, the surcharge applies automatically to every invoice and quote deposit. You do not need to turn it on per transaction.

If you want to waive the surcharge for a specific transaction, open the invoice or quote, scroll to the bottom of the page, and uncheck **Enable Surcharge Fee.** This affects only that transaction. Your organization-wide setting stays unchanged, and the surcharge still applies to every other invoice and quote.

Note:
  **Note**: When a surcharge is configured in Settings, it applies automatically to all automatic payments. See the [Automatic Payments](#automatic-payments) section below for compliance requirements.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > Turning off the surcharge for one invoice or quote

text:
Surcharge Fee > How the surcharge appears on a payment
When a customer pays an invoice or quote by credit card, Zuper calculates the surcharge using the rules described above and adds it to the payment total.

For example, suppose you have configured a **3% surcharge** for transactions between **\$1,001 and \$2,000**, and Yeeld determines that the full **3%** can be applied. If a customer pays a **\$2,000 invoice** by credit card, Zuper adds a **\$60.00 surcharge**, displays it as a separate line item, and presents a total payment amount of **\$2,060.00** for customer approval.

If Yeeld determines that the maximum allowable surcharge for the transaction is **2%**, Zuper applies a **\$40.00 surcharge** instead of **\$60.00**, even though your configured surcharge tier is **3%**.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > How the surcharge appears on a payment

text:
Surcharge Fee > How the surcharge appears on a payment > Payment Method Considerations
Surcharges apply to credit card payments only. If the customer pays with a debit or prepaid card, the surcharge is automatically removed, and the customer is charged the original invoice amount only.

Zuper supports surcharge collection for both card-present and card-not-present credit card transactions.

* **Card Present**
* **Card Not Present**

While the customer sees the surcharge added to their payment total, Zuper Pay calculates its own processing fee separately based on the payment method used and applies it to the full amount collected, including the surcharge. In the example above, the customer pays \$2,060.00, and Zuper Pay calculates its processing fee on that full \$2,060.00 before settling the remaining funds to your account.

Tip:
  Contact our support team at [support@zuper.co](mailto:support@zuper.co) to find out the processing fee that applies to your account.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > How the surcharge appears on a payment > Payment Method Considerations

text:
Surcharge Fee > Automatic Payments
Once you configure a surcharge in **Settings**, Zuper automatically applies it to eligible automatic credit card payments. You don't need to configure the surcharge separately for each transaction.

Warning:
  **Warning**: Before enabling surcharges for automatic payments, notify your customers at least **30 days in advance** that a surcharge will apply to their payments. This advance notice is required for compliance with card brand rules.

If a customer chooses not to continue with automatic payments, you can remove their saved card from the auto-charge setup. Zuper does not automatically remove saved cards based on customer responses.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > Automatic Payments

text:
Surcharge Fee > Processing Refunds
When you refund a transaction that included a surcharge, the surcharge is refunded in proportion to the refund amount.

* **Full refund:** The customer receives the full amount back, including the surcharge.
* **Partial refund:** The surcharge is partially refunded in proportion to the amount refunded.

Prohibited States
Surcharging is governed at the federal, card network, and U.S. state levels. Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, and Discover impose their own requirements, including a cap of the lower of 3% or the merchant's cost of acceptance. At the state level, some states prohibit or restrict surcharging entirely, while most allow it with conditions such as caps and disclosure requirements. Rules vary and may change.

Zuper automatically detects the service address ZIP code and disables the surcharge for restricted locations.

| State | Status |
| - | - |
| Maine | Prohibited |
| Massachusetts | Prohibited |
| Connecticut | Prohibited |
| California | Restrictions may apply |
| Mississippi | Restrictions may apply |
| New York | Restrictions may apply |

Warning:
  This list is subject to change. Rules vary by state and may change; for example, Oklahoma updated its surcharging rules in 2025. Always verify current state laws with your legal team before enabling surcharges.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > Processing Refunds

text:
Surcharge Fee > Frequently asked questions
**Can the surcharge go above 3%?**

    No. The surcharge is capped at the lower of 3% or your total average cost of credit card acceptance. Zuper's surcharge compliance service calculates the maximum allowable rate for each transaction based on card brand rules and state regulations. Whichever rate is lower applies.

**If I update my surcharge settings, will existing invoices be affected?**

    No. Your changes only apply to transactions processed after you save. To apply a new surcharge to an older invoice, void or delete it, and create a new one.

**Will the customer be prompted to confirm the surcharge before paying?**

    Yes. Regardless of the payment method, the customer sees a **Surcharge Notice** before the transaction is finalised. They must confirm before the payment is processed.

**Will the customer see the surcharge before they pay in the transaction?**

    Yes. The surcharge appears as a separate line item on the payment.

**What happens to the surcharge if I issue a full refund?**

    The full amount is refunded to the customer, including the surcharge.

**What happens to the surcharge on a partial refund?**

    Zuper refunds the surcharge in proportion to the total amount refunded, not just the invoice portion. For example, if you refund 50% of the invoice, 50% of the surcharge is also refunded.

**Can I waive the surcharge for one customer without changing my settings?**

    Yes. Open the invoice or quote, scroll to the bottom, and uncheck **Enable Surcharge Fee.** The surcharge will not apply to that transaction, and your settings remain unchanged for all other transactions.

**Do I need to notify my customers who make automatic payments?**

    Yes. You must notify your customers at least 30 days in advance before surcharges are applied to their automatic payments. This is a card brand compliance requirement.

**Will the surcharge I collect always cover my processing fee?**

    Not always. The surcharge is capped independently of your actual processing cost, so the rate allowed for a transaction can be lower than what you configured, and the amount collected may not fully offset your processing fee for that transaction.

metadata.title: Surcharge Fee > Frequently asked questions

text:
Tap to Pay on Android
Accept contactless payments anywhere with just your Android device — no card reader needed. With Tap to Pay on Android, you can securely accept Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, and payment cards with NFC (Near Field Communication) chips wherever you are.

**Requirements for Tap to Pay on Android** 

To enable Tap to Pay on Android, ensure the following requirements are met: 

* NFC-enabled Android device running **Android 9 or later** 
* The latest version of the Zuper Field Service mobile app (download from the **Google Play Store**) 

Note:
  Note: You must **input a location** for the Tap to Pay functionality to work properly. Ensure a valid location is configured before accepting payments. For more details, refer to this [article](https://docs.zuper.co/Zuper-pay/Settings#terminal-management).

**How to accept payments with Tap to Pay on Android** 

As you get started with Tap to Pay on Android, a best practice is to have your customer tap their phone near the back of the device. Note that this NFC spot is on the backside of Android devices, so be sure to turn your phone toward the customer with the screen facing you so that they may tap to pay with a card or phone.

1. Open the **Zuper Field Service** mobile app. 
2. Navigate to **Invoices** or **Quotes**, then select the transaction. 
3. Tap **Collect Payment / Collect Deposit**. 

4. Select **Tap to Pay on Android**, then ask the customer to:  

* Hold their **contactless card, NFC device, or digital wallet** (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay) over the **contactless payment symbol** on your mobile device.
* If using a smartwatch, ensure the watch is unlocked and placed close to the device. 

5. Once you see the **"Done"** screen, the transaction is complete!

metadata.title: Tap to Pay on Android

text:
Tap to Pay on iPhone
Zuper  Pay now offers the **Tap to Pay on iPhone** option, providing field service businesses with a seamless, secure, and hardware-free payment solution. This feature enables technicians to accept contactless payments directly on their iPhones, eliminating the need for additional payment terminals. 

 Customers can quickly and securely complete transactions by tapping their NFC-enabled credit or debit cards or using digital wallets like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay, even from an Apple Watch.

By adopting this mobile POS solution, Zuper helps businesses streamline payments, reduce hardware costs, and enhance the customer experience. 

**Requirements for Tap to Pay on iPhone** 

To enable **Tap to Pay** on iPhone, ensure the following requirements are met: 

* iPhone XS or later running iOS 16.7 or later 
* Latest version of the Zuper Field Service mobile app (download from the **App Store**) 

**How to activate Tap to Pay on iPhone** 

The activation process only needs to be completed once per organization. After activation, Tap to Pay on iPhone will be available on all compatible devices used by your team members. 

1\). Open the **Zuper Field Service** mobile app.

2\). Tap the **menu (☰) icon** in the top-left corner and select **Settings**.

3\). Choose **Tap to Pay on iPhone** and tap **Enable Now**. 

Note:
  Note: You must **input a location** for the Tap to Pay functionality to work properly. Ensure a valid location is configured before proceeding. For more details, refer to this [article](https://docs.zuper.co/Zuper-pay/Settings#terminal-management).

4\). Follow Apple’s onboarding process:  

* Review the **Tap to Pay on iPhone & Privacy** form, then tap **Agree** to proceed. 

* Use the Apple ID associated with your device or enter a different Apple ID (it must belong to you or your business).
* Tap **Continue** and follow the on-screen instructions.

5\). Once setup is complete, you’ll see an **Account Linked** confirmation message.

You’re now ready to accept contactless payments on your iPhone! 

**How to accept payments with Tap to Pay on iPhone**

metadata.title: Tap to Pay on iPhone

text:
Tap to Pay on iPhone
After enabling Tap to Pay on Mobile, you can accept payments for invoices or deposit quotes within the Zuper mobile app: 

1. Open the **Zuper Field Service** mobile app. 
2. Navigate to **Invoices** or **Quotes**, then select the transaction.
3. Tap **Collect Payment / Collect Deposit**.

4. Select **Tap to Pay on iPhone**, then ask the customer to:  

* Hold their **contactless card, NFC device, or digital wallet** (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay) over the **contactless payment symbol** on your mobile device. 
* If using a smartwatch, ensure the watch is unlocked and placed close to the device. 

5. Once you see the **"Done"** screen, the transaction is complete!

text:
Disputing transactions
A dispute, commonly referred to as a chargeback, arises when a customer rejects a payment they made to you through their bank or credit card provider. This can happen for various reasons.

If a dispute is filed, you can submit evidence supporting the legitimacy of the transaction. However, before proceeding with the dispute process, it is always advisable to first contact the customer directly. This allows you to understand why they filed the dispute and, in many cases, resolve the issue before it escalates.

If the dispute was made in error, the customer may withdraw it, and everything returns to normal. However, if the customer decides to proceed with the chargeback, financial institutions have a set process to protect consumers from unauthorized charges or unsatisfactory products and services. As a part of this process, the disputed payment amount will be withdrawn from your connected bank account, along with a dispute fee.

Please note that Zuper Pay adheres to the card network rules and has no control over this process. We cannot influence the outcome or the timeline of a dispute.

metadata.title: Disputing transactions

text:
Disputing transactions > Common types of disputes
Disputes can occur for various reasons. Each type requires different actions on your part. Here are the most common types:

* **Credit Not Processed**: The customer claims they are entitled to a refund because they returned the product, canceled the transaction, or didn’t use the service fully. However, you haven't processed the refund or credit yet.
* **Duplicate**: The customer claims they were charged multiple times for the same product or service.
* **Fraudulent**: This is the most frequent reason for disputes. It occurs when the customer claims they didn’t authorize the payment. This could be due to a genuine fraud or misunderstanding where the customer didn’t recognize a legitimate charge.
* **General**: This is an uncategorized dispute. In this case, contacting the customer is best to clarify why they’re disputing the charge.
* **Unrecognized**: The customer doesn’t recognize the payment on their statement.

Each type of dispute comes with its own unique set of requirements, so understanding the specific reason behind the dispute is key to resolving it efficiently.

metadata.title: Disputing transactions > Common types of disputes

text:
Disputing transactions > How to view dispute transactions
To view any dispute transactions in your Zuper Pay account, navigate to your **Zuper Pay Dashboard**. The dashboard overview has the option to **View all Disputes,** or you can filter out dispute transactions on the **Payments** listing page.

By selecting a specific dispute from the listing and clicking **View Details**, you can access comprehensive information about the dispute, including whether you want to **Accept** or **Counter** it.

metadata.title: Disputing transactions > How to view dispute transactions

text:
Disputing transactions > How to review the dispute and determine next steps
Once you identify a dispute, it is important to review all available information. Understand why the dispute occurred and decide whether it's based on a misunderstanding or a legitimate issue.

We recommend contacting your customer directly, as many disputes result from simple errors, such as forgetting a transaction or misinterpreting a charge. If they acknowledge the error, they may wish to withdraw the dispute.

Info:
  **Important:** Even if a customer confirms a chargeback was made in error, you must submit evidence to the bank. If the customer withdraws the chargeback, request written confirmation from their card issuer. Failing to provide evidence may result in losing the dispute, even if the chargeback is withdrawn.

Note:
  **Note:** Once a dispute is reported, all evidence must be submitted by the due date. Typically, this is 8-10 days from the dispute's reported date.

After contacting your customer, they are still going ahead with the dispute. There are two ways to move forward:

1.    **Accept dispute** – You can accept the dispute if you agree that the dispute is valid and the payment should be returned to the customer. Accepting a dispute does not negatively impact your business.

2.    **Counter dispute** – To counter a dispute, provide evidence to show the bank or card issuer that the charge to the customer is legitimate. For more details, see **How to counter a dispute**.

Depending on your choice, select the button to **Accept Dispute** or **Counter Dispute**.

Note:
  **Note:** A \$15 fee will be charged for disputing a transaction, and this fee will not be returned, even if the dispute is successful.

metadata.title: Disputing transactions > How to review the dispute and determine next steps

text:
Disputing transactions > How to counter a dispute
After clicking **Counter Dispute**, you will need to provide the necessary information and supporting evidence to help resolve the dispute in your favour.

**1. Dispute Details**

Provide all relevant information to explain why you should win the dispute and clarify the nature of the service or product. This includes:

* **Explanation**: Clearly explain why the dispute is invalid and why the charge is justified.
* **Service or Product Description**: Provide a detailed description of the product or service offered.
* **Service Date**: Include the date(s) when the service was provided or when the product was delivered.

**2. Customer and Billing Information**

Enter the customer’s details and billing information to confirm the transaction:

* **Customer’s Name**
* **Customer’s Email Address**
* **Billing Address**

**3. Supporting Evidence**

Upload all necessary documents and files that support your case. The types of evidence you may need to submit include:

* **Documentation of Communication**: Submit emails, text messages, or other forms of communication that demonstrate the service or product was provided as agreed.
* **Signed Agreements**: Upload any signed documents, such as contracts, quotes, or work orders, that prove the customer agreed to the service/product terms.
* **Photos or Videos**: Provide before-and-after photos (if applicable), screenshots of completed work, or any other visual evidence showing the service/product delivered.
* **Proof of Refund (if applicable)**: If the dispute is for the full charge amount but a partial refund has been issued, include evidence of the partial refund. This should include the amount refunded, the date, and a screenshot of the refund details.
* **Other Relevant Evidence:** This may include terms of service, GPS data, job logs, payment evidence, and proof of acceptance.

After completing these steps and uploading all necessary evidence, you will be directed to the final review page. Click “**Review**” to ensure all details are accurate and you’ve uploaded the correct supporting evidence.

Once you’re confident everything is in order, click **Submit** to finalize and submit your dispute response.

metadata.title: Disputing transactions > How to counter a dispute

text:
Disputing transactions > How to counter a dispute
**What Happens After Submitting Evidence**

After you submit your evidence, the customer’s bank will review the information and make a final decision about the dispute. Zuper Pay cannot influence this process or speed it up.

* If the dispute is resolved in your favour, the disputed amount and any fees will be returned to you. Note that the dispute resolution fee of \$15 will not be refunded.
* If the dispute is resolved in the customer’s favour, the disputed funds and fees will not be returned.

The timeline for dispute resolution is determined by the financial institution that issued the customer’s credit card.

metadata.title: Disputing transactions > How to counter a dispute

text:
Disputing transactions > How to counter a dispute > ACH disputes
Disputes related to ACH payments are relatively rare, as these are transactions that customers have deliberately authorized through their bank. ACH disputes follow a different process, managed by the **National Automated Clearinghouse Association (NACHA)**, which does not offer a chargeback mechanism like credit card networks.

When an ACH dispute is formalized, the funds are automatically returned to the customer, and unfortunately, these disputes cannot be contested. If an ACH dispute arises, we strongly recommend reaching out directly to your customer to resolve the issue.

metadata.title: Disputing transactions > How to counter a dispute > ACH disputes

text:
BBPOS WisePOS E Reader
The **BBPOS WisePOS** **E** Payment Reader is a smart countertop payment reader with handheld capability that integrates with the Zuper web app to process in-person payments efficiently. Whether you’re collecting deposits on quotes or processing invoice payments, this intuitive device ensures a smooth and secure card-present transaction experience. With support for multiple payment methods, including credit and debit cards (Swipe, Tap, Dip), customers can choose the payment method that suits them best.

The BBPOS Payment Reader reduces transaction costs by supporting card-present transactions, which incur lower processing fees compared to online or manually entered payments. With its robust integration, fast processing, and end-to-end encryption (E2EE), the BBPOS Payment Reader enhances business efficiency and customer satisfaction, delivering a frictionless payment experience.

Note:
  **Note**: The BBPOS WisePOS E is currently available only in the United States.

metadata.title: BBPOS WisePOS E Reader

text:
BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Order your BBPOS WisePOS E payment reader
To order a BBPOS WisePOS E payment reader, contact the Zuper support team at [support@zuper.co](mailto:support@zuper.co). The team will coordinate the ordering and shipping process and provide tracking details once the reader is shipped.

Setting up your BBPOS WisePOS E payment reader
Follow these steps to set up your payment reader:

1. **Install the battery**: Gently lift the back cover using the indentation in the bottom-left corner (use a coin or key, if needed). Slide the battery into its slot, ensuring the gold connectors align with the contacts at the top.
2. **Charge the device**: Connect the provided USB cable to the port marked with a lightning bolt symbol. Charge for 2–3 hours for a full battery, which provides approximately 8 hours of use. For countertop use, keep the device plugged in or docked to maintain power and receive automatic software updates.
3. **Power on the device**: Press and hold the power button for 2 seconds until the screen turns on and the right LED array flashes, indicating the device is ready.
4. **Power off or sleep**: To put the device to sleep, press the power button once. To power off, hold the power button until the “Power Off” option appears, then select it.
5. **Connect to the Internet:** The BBPOS WisePOS E requires an internet connection to process payments. Ensure the reader is on the same network as the device running the Zuper app.
   * **Wi-Fi**: Swipe right on the reader’s screen, tap **Settings**, enter the admin PIN (07139), and select **Network settings**. Choose a WPA-Personal or WPA2-Personal encrypted, password-protected Wi-Fi network. Non-password-protected or enterprise networks are not supported.
   * **Ethernet (Optional Dock)**: Connect the dock to a power source and an Ethernet cable. When docked, the reader uses the Ethernet connection instead of Wi-Fi. Ensure both cables are securely connected before docking.

For more detailed information, you can refer to the help article for [BBPOS WisePOS E](https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/payments/setup-reader/bbpos-wisepos-e) of Stripe.

metadata.title: BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Order your BBPOS WisePOS E payment reader

text:
BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Managing a location
To link your BBPOS WisePOS E to a specific physical or operational site for streamlined device management, create a location in the Zuper web app:

1. Log in to the Zuper web app with admin credentials.
2. Navigate to **Settings > Zuper Pay settings > Terminal Management**.
3. Click **Manage Location** to open the location listing page.
4. Click **Create Location** to create a new one.
5. On the Location creation page, enter the following details:
   * **Location Name**: E.g., "Field Team 1" or "Main Office".
   * **Address**: Provide the physical address or operational area.
6. Click **Proceed** to save the location. This will be used during device registration.

Note:
  **Note**: Each WisePOS E requires a unique location. Create multiple locations if managing numerous terminals.

metadata.title: BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Managing a location

text:
BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Registering the device
Register your BBPOS WisePOS E payment reader to associate it with your Zuper account and a specific location:

1. Log in to the Zuper web portal.
2. Go to **Settings > Zuper Pay > Terminal Management**.
3. Select **Register new devices**.
4. Power on the WisePOS E device:
   * Hold the power button on the right side for 2 seconds until the screen turns on.
   * Swipe right from the left edge of the screen, tap **Settings**, enter the admin PIN (for example - 07139), and select **Generate Pairing Code** to display a three-word hyphenated code (e.g., apple-banana-cherry).
5. In the Zuper web portal, enter the reader's name.
6. Enter the three-word code exactly as shown (including hyphens) in the **Registration Code** field.
7. Select the **location** created earlier from the dropdown.
8. Click **Proceed** to complete registration.

Note:
  **Note**: Verify the device’s serial number (on the back) matches the registered device. If the pairing code doesn’t work, reboot the device and generate a new code.

metadata.title: BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Registering the device

text:
BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Pair with the Zuper web app and collect payments
The BBPOS WisePOS E will seamlessly connect to the Zuper web app to process payments for invoices or quotes, enabling you to accept in-person payments efficiently. For security reasons, the reader must be paired and connected each time an invoice or quote payment is collected.

Follow these steps to pair the reader and collect payments:

1. Navigate to the **Invoices** or **Quotes** section.
2. Select the specific invoice or quote for which you want to collect payment.
3. Click **Collect Payment via Reader** to start the payment process.
4. Ensure the WisePOS E is powered on and connected to the same network as the device running the Zuper web app.
5. A list of available readers will appear, identified by their name (e.g., "Field Team 1 Reader") or serial number (found on the back of the device).
6. Choose the correct reader and click **Select**.

Note:
  **Note:** The reader can only connect to one device at a time. If the WisePOS E is already connected to a computer, a connection request from another computer will fail. Additionally, if another tab or window on the same computer discovers the reader, the connection to the first tab or window will fail, requiring the pairing process to be repeated.

Info:
  **Important:** For security reasons, the reader must be paired and connected for each payment collection session. This ensures secure transaction processing and prevents unauthorized access.

7. Once connected, the collect payment screen will display the name or serial number of the paired WisePOS E.
8. Ask the customer to swipe, dip, or tap their card on the reader.

Note:
  **Note:** Once the surcharge is configured for this transaction, the **Surcharge Notice** dialog appears, displaying the surcharge percentage and amount before the transaction is paid. Your customer must confirm the following statement before proceeding:

9. A confirmation payment will be displayed with details.  Successful payments trigger a confirmation sound; failed payments produce a distinct error sound.

metadata.title: BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Pair with the Zuper web app and collect payments

text:
BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Pair with the Zuper web app and collect payments > Payment Reader Updates
Zuper Payments reader, powered by Stripe, automatically updates the WisePOS E when not in use, typically at midnight in your timezone. Updates include security enhancements and new features.

Keep the reader powered on and plugged in (or docked) overnight to receive updates without interrupting sales.

* If unplugged, updates may start upon powering on, delaying use.
* To check for updates manually, reboot the device or go to **Settings > Diagnostics** (PIN 07139) to verify the latest software version (e.g., PCI firmware ID WSC5x).
* Failing to install required updates may prevent payment processing.

metadata.title: BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Pair with the Zuper web app and collect payments > Payment Reader Updates

text:
BBPOS WisePOS E Reader > Pair with the Zuper web app and collect payments > Troubleshooting
**Connection Issues:**

* Verify Wi-Fi/Ethernet connectivity in **Settings > Network settings**. Ensure the reader and the computer running the Zuper Web app are on the same WPA/WPA2 password-protected network.
* If the network disconnects or goes down during a payment attempt, restart the WisePOS E by holding the power button for 6 seconds to restore connectivity. Afterward, restart the payment process from the invoice or quote in the Zuper Web app.

**Payment Failures:**

* Ensure the card’s chip is correctly oriented and not blocked.
* The transaction may fail if the browser window is reloaded or closed during payment processing.

 **Pairing Issues:**

* Confirm that the correct three-word code is entered. Reboot and generate a new code if needed.
* Ensure the reader is paired for each payment session, as required for security.

**Power Issues**: When powering off, the WisePOS E may take a few seconds to fully transition to offline status.

***

text:
M2 Reader
The **M2** Payment Reader is an exclusive device that pairs seamlessly with the Zuper mobile app, enabling your field technicians to accept in-person payments with ease.

Whether you’re collecting **deposits on quotes** or processing **invoice payments**, this intuitive device ensures a smooth and secure card-present transaction experience. With support for multiple payment methods, including credit and debit cards (Swipe, Tap, Dip), customers can choose the payment method that suits them best.

Beyond convenience, the **Zuper Payment Reader** also helps businesses save on transaction costs. Since it supports card-present transactions, it offers lower processing fees compared to online or manually entered payments, making it a cost-effective solution for businesses of all sizes. With its seamless integration, fast processing, and secure encryption, the Zuper Payment Reader enhances both business efficiency and customer satisfaction, ensuring a frictionless payment experience every time.

Note:
    **Note**: The Zuper Payment Reader is currently available only in the United States.

metadata.title: M2 Reader

text:
M2 Reader > How to order an M2 Payment Reader
To order your M2 Payment Reader, please contact our Support team. You can request an M2 Payment Reader, and Zuper will take care of the ordering and shipping for you. You will receive a notification once your payment reader has been shipped and is ready for use.

metadata.title: M2 Reader > How to order an M2 Payment Reader

text:
M2 Reader > How to order an M2 Payment Reader > Setting up your Payment Reader
Once your M2 payment reader arrives, set it up with your mobile device to begin collecting payments in person.

**When you first receive your payment reader:**

* Fully charge the device using the provided charging cable.
* Ensure that the payment reader is up to date.

To use the Zuper M2 Payment Reader, make sure Bluetooth is enabled on your mobile device and follow the pairing instructions below:

1. **Turn on the payment reader**: Press the power button located on the right side of the device.

2.  **Enable the necessary settings on your mobile device**:

* Enable Bluetooth

Note:
  **Note**: After enabling Bluetooth on your device, the payment reader will appear as a payment method in the app. However, additional setup is required for the first use.

* Allow location access for the Zuper app:
  * For **Apple devices**, go to **Settings** > **Privacy & Security** > **Location Services**, and enable location for the Zuper app.
  * For **Android devices**, go to **Settings** > **Apps** > **Zuper**, and grant permission for "Location" and "Nearby Devices."

Note:
  **Note**: You must **input a location** for the Tap to Pay and terminal payment functionalities to work properly. Please ensure that a valid location is configured in the Zuper app. For more details, refer to this [article](https://docs.zuper.co/Zuper-pay/Settings#terminal-management).

3.    **Pair your payment reader**:

* Navigate to an invoice that is either awaiting payment or past due and select **Collect Payment**.
* Choose **Collect via Terminal** as your payment method. Your device will begin searching for the payment reader automatically.
* Select **Pair** to link the payment reader with your mobile device. The device will update automatically, which may take around 15 seconds.

Note:
  **Note**: Pairing the payment reader during the initial setup is recommended to ensure the update is completed before you start collecting payments.

metadata.title: M2 Reader > How to order an M2 Payment Reader > Setting up your Payment Reader

text:
M2 Reader > How to order an M2 Payment Reader > Collecting payments using the Payment Reader
Once your payment reader is set up, you can collect payments directly from invoices or deposits on quotes:

1. In the Zuper app, select **Collect Payment** or **Collect Deposit** for an invoice or quote.
2. Choose **Collect via Terminal** as your payment method.
3. When prompted, turn on your payment reader.
4. Once connected, swipe, tap, or insert the customer’s card to complete the transaction.

text:
M2 Reader > How to order an M2 Payment Reader > Payment Reader updates
Zuper Payments is powered by Stripe, which manages software updates for the Zuper Pay Reader. The device will automatically receive updates from Stripe when not in use, typically around midnight in your time zone.

To ensure your payment reader stays up to date, leave it plugged in overnight. If it is unplugged, the update will occur the next time you turn the device on. You can manually check for updates by rebooting the payment reader.

text:
AI Job Summary
> Powered by AI, this feature provides a quick, intelligent overview of key job details—including category, status, assignments, parts, tasks, and timelines—presented as a clear, structured summary within the Job Details page, helping you grasp the job context at a glance.

**Powered by AI**, the **AI Job Summary** feature provides a quick, intelligent overview of any job, neatly structured and displayed within the Job Details page. From job category and status to assignment, parts, tasks, and timelines, Zuper AI compiles all relevant job data into a clear, structured summary- helping you grasp the job context at a glance.

This feature is especially useful for managers reviewing job progress, technicians cross-verifying details, and support teams validating records, as it summarizes everything in a clean, easy-to-read format, reducing the time spent scanning through multiple sections.

Note:
  **Note:** This feature is available only on select Zuper plans. To enable it for your account, please contact your account administrator or email us at [support@zuper.co](mailto:support@zuper.co)

metadata.title: AI Job Summary

text:
AI Job Summary > Accessing the AI Job Summary
To view the AI Job Summary:

1. Click the “**Jobs**” module from the left navigation menu.

2. Select any of the Jobs from the jobs listing page. The selected job details page will appear.
3. Click the **Zuper AI** icon at the bottom right corner of the job details page.

4. Select **“View Job Summary.”**

The AI-generated summary will appear in a modal window with an intuitive layout.

metadata.title: AI Job Summary > Accessing the AI Job Summary

text:
AI Job Summary > Accessing the AI Job Summary > What the Job Summary Includes
The AI Job Summary provides a holistic, auto-generated view of the job, allowing you to quickly assess the job’s context, progress, and associated records—all in a single glance. Below is a breakdown of the information included:

1. **Job Overview**

Displays a concise overview of the job, highlighting essential details such as **job title**, ****priority level, category, status, route, job location, andscheduled time**** .
This helps you instantly understand what the job is, where and when it's happening, and its current status.

2. **Job Assignment**

Lists the assigned technician or team along with assignment-specific details, giving clarity on who is responsible for executing the job.

3. **Job Timeline**

Outlines timestamped events across the job lifecycle, including creation, travel start, job start, pause/resume actions, and completion—helping you track progress step by step.

4. **Status Progression**

Shows the status history in real time, detailing the current job status and when it last changed (e.g., *On My Way since February 27, 2025 at 10:54 PM*).

5. **Service Tasks**

Displays the task execution type (e.g., Serial or Parallel) along with completion details, such as the number of tasks completed out of the total assigned.

6. **Parts, Services, and Expense**

Summarizes all parts used and services provided, including quantities, descriptions, and total cost, offering transparency on material and labor usage.

7. **Associated Records**

Lists all related records associated with the job, such as linked assets, invoices, quotes, and other supporting information that contribute to a complete job history.

Note:
  **Note:** At the top right of the summary window, you’ll find a timestamp indicating when the job was last modified.

  Example: Last updated: February 26, 2025, at 03:45 PM

metadata.title: AI Job Summary > Accessing the AI Job Summary > What the Job Summary Includes

text:
AI Job Summary > Accessing the AI Job Summary > Additional Actions
Within the summary window, the following quick actions are available:

* **Print** – Print a copy of the AI-generated job summary for documentation or offline sharing.
* **Close** – Closes the summary window.
* **Esc** – Press Esc on your keyboard to quickly close the summary.
* **Toggle Docking** – Switch between a docked sidebar and a floating panel based on your screen preference.

metadata.title: AI Job Summary > Accessing the AI Job Summary > Additional Actions

text:
AI Take and Talk
> Powered by AI, this feature allows users to capture a photo and add a voice description that’s instantly transcribed and tagged with the image.

Zuper’s mobile app now features a new “**Take and Talk**” mode within the photo option in the Notes section. This functionality allows users to **capture a photo and immediately** **provide a description using voice input,** which is automatically **transcribed and saved along with the image**, making it tagged to the picture taken. This ensures that both visual and contextual details are captured in one seamless step.

Note:
  **Note:** This feature is available only on select Zuper plans. To enable it for your account, please contact your account administrator or email us at [support@zuper.co](mailto:support@zuper.co)

While this feature improves job site documentation by making it faster, easier, and more accurate, it also offers significant advantages for field technicians:

* **Increased efficiency**: Technicians can use it when multiple pictures need to be taken, and context needs to be added for each picture in real time without needing to stop and type.
* **Better accuracy**: Voice descriptions are transcribed instantly, reducing the risk of missing or unclear information.
* **Hands-free convenience**: Ideal for use in environments where technicians are wearing gloves or working hands-on.
* **Enhanced clarity for office teams**: Photos paired with transcribed context provide better visibility for the back office or supervisors when reviewing, quoting, or approving work.

This step-by-step instruction will guide you through using the “**Take and Talk**” mode in the Zuper mobile app:

metadata.title: AI Take and Talk

text:
AI Take and Talk > How to Use Take and Talk Mode
To use this feature in the Zuper mobile app, follow these steps:

1. Open the Zuper mobile app.
2. Navigate to the job where you want to add a note.
3. Tap the **Add note** tab within the job details screen. The camera will open automatically.
4. Tap the **Photo** section and activate **Take and Talk mode** by tapping the icon at the top right of the photo section.

5. Once **Take and Talk mode is active**, capture a clear photo of the subject (e.g., completed work, issue, or equipment).
6. After taking the photo, you’ll be immediately prompted to begin speaking. Your voice input will be automatically transcribed and tagged as a description of the image.

7. Tap the  (tick) icon to proceed.

8. Review the description tagged to the captured image, then click **Attach** to add the image with its description to the note.

9. Click **Submit** to save the note.

metadata.title: AI Take and Talk > How to Use Take and Talk Mode

text:
AI Take and Talk > How to Use Take and Talk Mode > Edit Description
You can edit the description either before or after saving it using the **microphone input** or **manual editing** options.

**To Edit Before Saving**

    To edit the description before saving, **tap the transcribed text** tagged to the image during the review step.

    You have two editing options:

    * **Microphone Input**
      Tap the microphone icon to add additional voice input. The new input will be transcribed and automatically appended to the existing description.
    * **Manual Editing**
      Tap inside the text field to manually modify the transcribed content using the on-screen keyboard. You can correct, add, or remove text as needed.

**To Edit After Saving**

    If you need to make changes after the note has been saved:

    1. On the **Add Note** page, locate the note you want to edit.
    2. Tap the (Kebab icon) on the image.
    3. Select **Edit** from the menu.

    4. Make the necessary changes using **microphone input** or **manual editing** options, then click **Add** to update the note.

metadata.title: AI Take and Talk > How to Use Take and Talk Mode > Edit Description

text:
AI Take and Talk > How to Use Take and Talk Mode > Refine Description with AI Capabilities
Zuper also offers AI-powered tools to further enhance your notes. These features help improve clarity, correctness, and accessibility:

* **Summarize**
  Condenses long descriptions into a clear, concise summary, making notes easier to read and understand.
* **Clean Up**
  Automatically corrects grammar, spelling, punctuation, and sentence structure for professional, polished content.
* **Translate**
  Instantly translates notes into any of 17 supported languages, including Dutch, French, Slovenian, and Spanish—broadening accessibility for global teams.

metadata.title: AI Take and Talk > How to Use Take and Talk Mode > Refine Description with AI Capabilities

text:
Capturing Photos
> Powered by AI, this feature allows technicians to capture images and record voice input simultaneously during a job. Zuper AI then transcribes and summarizes the spoken content, combining it with the captured images to automatically generate a clear and structured job note.

The **AI Walkthrough Note** feature in the Zuper mobile app is designed to simplify and enhance job documentation for field technicians. Powered by advanced AI technology, this feature supports recording **videos, capturing photos, and recording audio** during a job. After the walkthrough session, Zuper AI automatically transcribes and summarizes the recorded audio, combining it with your captured media to create a clear, organized job note.

This eliminates manual data entry, reduces documentation time, and ensures accurate, professional records of the work performed.

In this guide, we will focus on **how to capture photos** using the AI Walkthrough Note feature effectively, step by step.

Warning:
  **Prerequisite**: Ensure that the feature is enabled for your organization. If it is not enabled, contact our account admin or email [**support@zuper.co**](mailto:support@zuper.co) to have it enabled.

metadata.title: Capturing Photos

text:
Capturing Photos
**Android**

    * Open the Zuper mobile app.
    * Navigate to the Job Details page.
    * Tap **Add Note**. The camera will launch automatically.
    * Go to the **Walkthrough** option.
    * Switch to the **camera mode** at the bottom of the screen.

    * Click “**Start Walkthrough**” to begin the session.

**iOS**

    * Open the Zuper mobile app.
    * Navigate to the Job Details page.
    * Tap **Add Note**. The camera will launch automatically.
    * Go to the **WALKTHROUGH PHOTO** option.

    * Click “**Start Walkthrough**” to begin the session.

Note:
  **Note**: You can capture multiple photos while recording audio.

* Once you're done, your recording will be prepared for preview.
* After previewing, you’ll be directed to the **Add Note** page, where Zuper AI will automatically generate a summary of your recorded audio, improving clarity, spelling, and grammar.

* Tap **Save**. The summarized note, along with the captured images, will be added to the job notes successfully.

metadata.title: Capturing Photos

text:
Capturing Photos > Editing the Note (Optional)
After AI generates the summarized note, you can modify it as needed:

* Tap on the "**Summarized by AI**" section to open the **Edit Note** screen.
* Choose from two editing options:
  1. **Microphone Input** – Use your microphone to speak and add more details to the note.
  2. **Manual Editing** – Use the keyboard to make changes to the text manually.

metadata.title: Capturing Photos > Editing the Note (Optional)

text:
Capturing Photos > Enhancing the Note with AI
After you've edited the note, you can further refine it using the AI capabilities listed below before saving.

* **Summarize** – Condenses lengthy notes into clear, concise content.
* **Clean up** – Corrects grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
* **Translate** – Convert notes into 17 different languages, including Dutch, French, Slovenian, and Spanish.

The summarized note, along with any captured images, will be successfully added to the job notes.

metadata.title: Capturing Photos > Enhancing the Note with AI

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode
The **AI Walkthrough Note** feature helps technicians capture clear and detailed job notes in the field. With the latest update, you can:

* Record short videos.
* Use **Dual-Camera Mode** to capture video from both front and rear cameras simultaneously.
* Pause and resume recordings without starting over.
* Take photos while recording video

After the walkthrough session, Zuper AI will transcribe and summarize your audio, combining it with the videos and photos to create clear, organized job notes.

In this guide, we will walk you through how to capture videos and use dual camera mode in the AI Walkthrough note feature effectively, step by step, so you can create detailed, accurate job notes with minimal effort.

Warning:
  Prerequisite: Ensure that the feature is enabled for your organization. If it is not enabled, contact our account admin or email [support@zuper.co](mailto:support@zuper.co) to have it enabled.

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Benefits
The AI Walkthrough Note feature acts like a personal assistant on-site, capturing every detail while you focus on the work. When combined with Dual Camera Mode, it provides a comprehensive way to document jobs.

* **Live Documentation**: Capture photos and videos in real time, building a complete virtual notebook without pausing work
* **Voice Transcription**: Speak naturally while AI converts your speech into clear, readable notes.
* **AI-Powered Summarizing**: Automatically removes filler words, corrects grammar, and organizes content into concise summaries.
* **Dual Perspective Recording**: Record simultaneously from front and rear cameras to capture both the technician's viewpoint and the project context.
* **Improved Communication**: Multimedia notes help explain complex project details to clients and team members.
* **Time-Saving Notes**: Automatic transcription and AI summaries reduce manual note-taking.
* **Flexible Editing and Translation**: Edit AI-generated notes or translate them into multiple languages for better accessibility.

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Benefits

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Capturing a Short Video
**Android**

    * Open the Zuper mobile app.
    * Navigate to the Job Details page.
    * Tap **Add Not**e – the camera will launch automatically.
    * Go to the **Walkthrough** option.
    * Switch to **video mode** at the bottom of the screen.

**iOS**

    * Open the Zuper mobile app.
    * Navigate to the Job Details page.
    * Tap **Add Note** – the camera will launch automatically.
    * Go to the **WALKTHROUGH VIDEO** option.

* Click “**Start Walkthrough**” to begin the session.

Once the recording starts, you can **speak naturally while capturing the video**. The app will automatically **transcribe your speech into text** in real time.

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Capturing a Short Video

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Using Dual Camera Mode
**Android**

    * Open the Zuper mobile app.
    * Navigate to the Job Details page.
    * Tap **Add Note** – the camera will launch automatically.
    * Go to the **Walkthrough** option.
    * Switch to **video mode** at the bottom of the screen.

    * Tap the **dual camera icon** and click “**Start Walkthrough**” to begin your dual-view presentation, showcasing both your narrative and the project scene.

**iOS**

    * Open the Zuper mobile app.
    * Navigate to the Job Details page.
    * Tap **Add Note** – the camera will launch automatically.
    * Go to the **WALKTHROUGH VIDEO** option.

    * Tap the **dual camera** icon and click “**Start Walkthrough**” to begin the session.

Info:
  While recording, keep in mind that you can:

  * **Record up to 3 minutes** per walkthrough.
  * **Capture photos at any time** during the recording by tapping the **Camera icon** at the bottom right of the screen.
  * Say “**Snap**” to instantly capture a photo without tapping any buttons.
  * **Temporarily stop and restart both the video and transcription** by tapping the **Pause/Resume** options at the bottom left of the screen.

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Using Dual Camera Mode

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Using Dual Camera Mode > Review Your Attachments
After recording a video (and capturing any photos during the session), you will be directed to the Review Attachments screen. Here you can:

* **Preview** videos and photos you captured.
* **Add tags** using the “**+ Add tag**” button to categorize images.

When you are satisfied:

* Tap **Finish** to proceed.
* You’ll be redirected to the **Add Note** page, where the captured video and images are displayed.
* Zuper AI will automatically process your audio, generating a polished summary with corrected spelling, grammar, and clear structure.
* Finally, tap **Save**. The summarized note, along with the recorded videos and photos, will be added to the job notes successfully.

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Using Dual Camera Mode > Review Your Attachments

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Using Dual Camera Mode > Editing and Enhancing the Note (Optional)
Once AI generates a summarized note, you can edit or enhance it before saving:

1. **Edit**: Tap the “Summarized by AI” section to open the Edit Note screen. You can either:
   * Microphone Input: Speak to add more details.
   * Manual Editing: Use the keyboard to make changes.
2. **Enhance with AI**: Refine your note using AI options:
   * Summarize: Condense lengthy notes.
   * Clean Up: Correct grammar, spelling, and structure.
   * Translate: Convert notes into 17 languages, including Dutch, French, Slovenian, and Spanish.

The final note, along with captured images and videos, will be added to the job notes.

For detailed steps on editing and enhancing your notes, [Click here](https://docs.zuper.co/Zuper_AI/AI_Walkthrough_Note/Capturing_Photo#editing-the-note-optional)

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Using Dual Camera Mode > Editing and Enhancing the Note (Optional)

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Offline Capabilities
The AI Walkthrough Note feature also supports limited offline functionality, allowing technicians to continue capturing essential job details even without an active internet connection.

Here’s what you can do offline:

* **Walkthrough Video Recording**: Record walkthrough videos (up to 3 minutes).
* **Dual Camera Mod**e: Use dual camera to capture video from both front and rear cameras simultaneously.
* **Transcription (iOS Only)**: On iOS devices, audio transcription will continue to work offline, ensuring your voice input is converted to text.
  1. On Android devices, transcription will not work offline. However, you can still record videos with voice input. Your voice will be captured as part of the video but will not be transcribed until the device reconnects to the internet.
* **AI Capabilities**: AI-powered features such as Summarization, Clean Up, and Translate require an internet connection and are not available offline on either platform.

Once the device reconnects to the internet, you can go to the note containing the recorded content to perform Zuper AI actions, such as transcribing audio (if applicable) and applying AI enhancements like summarization or translation.

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Offline Capabilities

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Best Practices
1. Ensure a stable internet connection for a smooth recording experience.
2. Use dual camera mode for specific purposes, such as:
   * Training: Make detailed videos for new team members, showing tasks with live commentary.
   * Sales: Create engaging videos that highlight the quality and progress of your work.
   * Marketing: Produce promotional videos showcasing both you and your completed projects.
3. Add tags to images for quick search and categorization.
4. Always preview and edit notes before saving.

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > Best Practices

text:
Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > FAQs
1. What is Dual Camera mode?

   Dual Camera mode allows you to record using both the front and rear cameras at the same time. This gives you a more comprehensive view of the job site, capturing both your perspective and the surroundings.
2. How do I enable Dual Camera mode?

   Select Video mode in the Walkthrough notes option, then tap the Dual Camera icon at the bottom right before starting the walkthrough.
3. Why don’t I see the Dual Camera option on my device?

   Dual Camera mode is available only on supported mobile devices. The feature is not supported on tablets, including both Android and iOS models, so the option may not appear on those devices.
4. What is the maximum video length I can record?

   You can record videos up to 3 minutes in length.
5. Can I take photos while recording a video?

   Yes. While recording a video, you can capture photos in two ways:

   * Tap the **camera icon** on the screen at any time during video recording.
   * Say “**Snap**” to take a photo hands-free while continuing the video.
6. Why can’t I add more pictures to a note?

   If you encounter issues adding more pictures, it may be due to a system limitation or an account setting. Please contact Zuper support for assistance.

***

metadata.title: Capturing Videos and using Dual Camera Mode > FAQs

text:
AI Voice Notes
> The AI Voice Notes feature in the Zuper mobile app lets technicians speak instead of type when entering text in job notes, checklists, or inspection forms.

The **AI Voice Notes** feature in the Zuper mobile app helps technicians save time and effort by allowing them to speak instead of typing. Wherever text input is required, such as job notes, checklists, or inspection forms, technicians can simply tap the **microphone** icon to record their voice. Zuper AI will automatically transcribe the audio into clean, structured text.

Note:
  **Note:** This feature is available only on select Zuper plans. To enable it for your account, please contact your account administrator or email us at [support@zuper.co](mailto:support@zuper.co)

This feature is especially useful for adding lengthy descriptions or detailed observations without requiring manual typing. It improves documentation speed, reduces manual effort, and ensures accurate records.

This guide will walk you through how to use AI Voice Notes efficiently step by step.

metadata.title: AI Voice Notes

text:
AI Voice Notes > Using AI voice notes
Follow these steps to use the **AI Voice Notes** feature:

1. **Open the Zuper mobile app** on your device.
2. **Navigate to the Job Details page** of the job you’re working on.
3. You can use AI Voice Notes feature in the following areas:
   * **Job Notes**
   * **Checklist fields**
   * **Inspection forms**

**AI Voice Notes in Job Notes**

    To use voice notes in **Job Notes**:

    1. Navigate to the **Notes** tab on the Job Details page.
    2. Tap the **“+” icon** to add a new note.
    3. On the **Add Note** page, you’ll see a **microphone icon** in the text input field.

    4. **Tap the microphone icon** to start recording your voice.
    5. **Speak clearly and naturally.** Zuper AI will transcribe your speech into text in real time.
    6. Once done, tap the  **icon**.

**AI Voice Notes in Checklists & Inspection Forms**

    To use voice notes in a checklist or inspection form:

    1. Tap "**Update Status**" on the Job Details page to begin progressing the job.
    2. If a **checklist or inspection form** is linked to the job:
       * You must complete the required fields before updating the job status.
    3. Locate the **multiline text fields** within the checklist or form that require input.
    4. **Tap the microphone icon** next to the field to begin recording your voice.

    5. **Speak clearly and naturally.** Zuper AI will transcribe your speech into neatly formatted text in real time.
    6. Once you're done, tap the  **icon**  to confirm and proceed.

**Review** the transcribed text for accuracy and click **Submit** to save the voice notes.

metadata.title: AI Voice Notes > Using AI voice notes

text:
AI Voice Notes > Editing the Transcript
Once the transcript is generated, you can make changes as needed.

1. Tap the generated transcript to open the transcription page.
2. Choose from the following editing options:
   * **Microphone Input** – Use the microphone to speak and add more details to the voice notes.
   * **Manual Editing** – Use the keyboard to manually modify the text.

This flexibility ensures that your voice notes are accurate and complete before saving.

metadata.title: AI Voice Notes > Editing the Transcript

text:
AI Voice Notes > Editing the Transcript > Enhancing voice notes with AI
After editing, you can further refine your voice notes using the following AI capabilities:

* **Summarize** – Condenses lengthy text into a clear, concise summary.
* **Clean Up** – Fixes grammar, spelling, and sentence structure for better readability.
* **Translate** – Converts text into 17 different languages, including Dutch, French, Slovenian, and Spanish.

metadata.title: AI Voice Notes > Editing the Transcript > Enhancing voice notes with AI

text:
AI Voice Notes > Editing the Transcript > Submitting the voice notes
Once refined, the voice note will display the label **“Summarized/Translated by Zuper AI.”**

* Review the AI-enhanced voice note.
* Tap **Submit** to save the voice note.

This feature significantly improves the speed and accuracy of job documentation, allowing you to focus more on the job itself rather than on data entry.

***

Note:
  **Does Zuper automatically translate job descriptions and notes?** No. Your
 configured language setting localizes the Zuper interface (menus, labels,
 and buttons) but does not translate free-text content, such as job
 descriptions and notes — this content always displays in the language it
 was entered in. To share notes with team members in another language, use
 the AI notes Translate option, which converts notes into 17 supported
 languages, including Spanish.

text:
Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form
The **AI Walkthrough Video** field lets field executives record a video walkthrough directly from their mobile app while completing a job checklist or inspection form. Instead of relying solely on written notes, field executives can capture a visual record of the site, equipment, or work completed — giving your team richer context for every job.

This field works in two places:

* A[ **job checklist**](https://docs.zuper.co/Settings/Modules/Jobs/Configuring-job-checklist) that appears when a field executive updates a job status.
* An [**inspection form**](https://docs.zuper.co/Settings/Modules/Jobs/Configuring_inspection_form) accessed from the [**Tasks**](https://docs.zuper.co/Zuper_Dashboard/Tasks) or [**Assets**](https://docs.zuper.co/Contracts_and_Assets_Management/Assets/Inspection_form) module.

Once submitted, the video, photo thumbnails, and an AI-generated summary are available inline for anyone reviewing the record in the back office.

metadata.title: Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form

text:
Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Adding a field in the checklist
Admins add the **AI Walkthrough Video** field to a checklist or inspection form in Settings. Once you save the field, it appears to field executives in the mobile app when they update a job status or complete an inspection form. The user cannot record the AI walkthrough video from a desktop.

1. From the left navigation menu, Select **Settings**
2. Select **Modules**, then Choose **Jobs**.
3. Select **Job Category Hub** and open the job category you want to update.
4. In the **Checklist** section, select **+Create** to build a new checklist, or select an existing checklist to edit it.
5. In the **Checklist Builder**, locate **AI Walkthrough Video** in the Media category on the right panel.
6. Drag **AI Walkthrough Video** from the right panel and drop it into the checklist. The **Edit AI Walkthrough Video** panel opens on the right.

7. Enter a **Field Name**.
8. Under **Configuration**, toggle **Mark as Required Field** on to require the walkthrough before the checklist can be submitted.
9. Select **Save** to add the field to the checklist.

Note:
  Note: To add AI Walkthrough field to an inspection form, follow the steps in Configuring [inspection forms](https://docs.zuper.co/Settings/Modules/Jobs/Configuring_inspection_form#customizing-the-inspection-form).

  To learn more about checklists, see Configure [job checklists](https://docs.zuper.co/Settings/Modules/Jobs/Configuring-job-checklist#adding-fields-to-the-checklist).

metadata.title: Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Adding a field in the checklist

text:
Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Capturing a walkthrough in a checklist > Open the checklist
When you update a job status, and the checklist is configured with an AI walkthrough video, follow these steps:

1. Go to the **Jobs** module.

2. From the job listing page, select the job you are working on to open the job details page.
3. Tap **Update Status** — the checklist attached to the current job status opens

Start the walkthrough
4. Locate the **AI Walkthrough Video** field in the checklist and tap **Start Walkthrough**. The camera opens automatically.
5. Select a camera mode. **Dual Camera** records from both front and rear cameras at the same time, and **Single Camera** records from one camera only.

*Fields marked with  (\*) are required.* Complete them before you submit the checklist.

6. Walk through the job site. Speak naturally — Zuper AI transcribes your voice in real time.
7. Tap the **camera** icon at the bottom of the screen to capture photos at any point during the recording.
8. Tap **Pause** if you need to stop temporarily, then tap **Resume** to continue.
9. Tap **Stop** when the recording is complete.

Note:
  **Note:** Each session records a single video up to 3 minutes long. On the recording preview screen, select **Add images** or **Clear text** from the context menu to add more photos or remove the transcribed text.

metadata.title: Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Capturing a walkthrough in a checklist > Open the checklist

text:
Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Capturing a walkthrough in a checklist > Review and attach
10. Review the video preview. The preview screen shows the full recording. Verify the video to ensure the footage is complete and clear before attaching it.
11. Check the photo thumbnails below the video preview. Tap any thumbnail to open the full image and confirm it is usable.

To add a tag or description, enter your text in the field that appears and tap **Done**. To remove a photo, select **Delete**.

12. Tap **Attach all** to attach the video and photos to the checklist.

metadata.title: Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Capturing a walkthrough in a checklist > Review and attach

text:
Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Capturing a walkthrough in a checklist > Submit the checklist
13. Complete any remaining required fields in the checklist.
14. Tap **Submit** at the bottom of the checklist screen.

Note:
  **Note:** If the **AI Walkthrough Video** field is marked as required, the **Submit** button stays inactive until you attach the walkthrough. You do not need to wait for the AI summary to generate before submitting.

What happens after you submit

Once you submit, the **AI Walkthrough Video** field displays the video, any photos, and the AI Walkthrough Summary. The summary generates in the background and does not hold up the checklist or job completion — Zuper marks both as complete straightaway.

To correct the summary after submission, reopen the job, select the draft checklist, tap the **Summary** text field within the **AI Walkthrough Video** field, make your changes, and tap **Submit**.

2.    Go to the **Checklist** tab.

3.    Select the submitted checklist.

The **AI Walkthrough Video** field displays the video, photo thumbnails, and the AI Walkthrough Summary inline.

text:
Record a Walkthrough Video on a Checklist & Inspection Form > Frequently Asked Questions
**What happens if I close the app while recording?**

    The recording stops. Reopen the checklist and tap the **AI Walkthrough Video** field to start a new recording. Zuper does not save incomplete recordings.

**Can I re-record the walkthrough after I have submitted?**

    Yes. Open the job on mobile, select the checklist, and tap **Edit** to modify or replace the walkthrough.

**The AI summary shows Generating summary… for a long time. Is something wrong?**

    AI processing normally takes a few seconds to about a minute. If you were offline when you recorded, the summary will not generate until you reconnect to the internet. Once you are online, the summary updates automatically.

    If the issue continues, contact [Support](mailto:support@zuper.co).
