text:
Albums
Albums organize your job photos into named folders. Find what you need in one tap and share an entire folder with a customer or colleague as a single link. This article covers adding photos to an album, sharing albums, removing photos, and annotating album photos, all from the Zuper mobile app.

Info:
  Albums are available on both active and completed jobs. You can add photos to an album at any time, regardless of job status.

metadata.title: Albums

text:
Albums > Before you begin
* Roofing accounts include six default albums. For all other account types, your admin creates albums in **Settings** > **Modules** > **Jobs** > **Gallery Settings**. The **Albums** tab appears in the mobile gallery as soon as at least one album exists.
* Sharing via text message requires a Zuper Connect subscription. The **Text** tab is available to Zuper Connect subscribers only — contact your admin to confirm whether it is included in your plan.

metadata.title: Albums > Before you begin

text:
Albums > Navigation
**Hamburger menu** > **Jobs** > **\[Job name]** > **(⋯) context menu** > **Gallery** > **Albums tab**

The gallery opens on the **Photos** tab by default. The **Albums** tab sits at the bottom of the screen, next to **Photos**.

Opening the gallery
1. Tap the hamburger menu icon at the top left of the screen. The main navigation menu opens.

2. From the **Jobs** list, tap the job you want to work on.
3. On the job details screen, tap the **(⋯)** context menu at the top right.
4. Tap the **Gallery** from the list.

5. The **Gallery** screen opens, showing the **Photos** tab by default. Tap the **Albums** tab at the bottom of the screen.

5. Your albums appear as folder thumbnails, each showing the album name.

metadata.title: Albums > Navigation

text:
Albums > Adding photos to an album > Method 1: From the Photos tab
You can add photos to an album in two ways: from the **Photos** tab in the gallery, or from inside an album.

Method 1: From the Photos tab
Use this method to add photos already in the job gallery to an album.

1. Open the gallery and tap the **Photos** tab.
2. Tap and hold any photo to start selecting.

3. Tap the **Add to Album** icon at the bottom right of the screen. The **Add to Album** sheet opens, listing all available albums for this job. Add the photos to the album.

3. Tap **Share** to share the album immediately or tap **Copy Link** to copy the album link to your clipboard.

metadata.title: Albums > Adding photos to an album > Method 1: From the Photos tab

text:
Albums > Adding photos to an album > Method 2: From inside an album
Use this method when you want to capture a new photo or add a photo from the job gallery directly into a specific album.

1. Open the gallery and tap the **Albums** tab.
2. Tap the album you want to add photos to. The album detail screen opens.
3. Tap the **(+)** button at the bottom right of the screen. A sub-menu appears with two options:
   * **Add from Job** — select from photos already in the job gallery.
   * **Camera** — capture a new photo directly into this album.
4. Tap your preferred option and complete the action.

Note:
  Photos added using **Add from Job** or **Camera** are automatically synced back to the job gallery. Removing a photo from an album later does not delete it from the job gallery.

metadata.title: Albums > Adding photos to an album > Method 2: From inside an album

text:
Albums > Sharing an album > Method 1: Long-press from the Albums tab
Album links are view-only. Recipients can browse every photo but cannot make changes. Open the sharing options from the **Albums** tab or from inside the album.

Method 1: Long-press from the Albums tab
1. Open the gallery and tap the **Albums** tab.
2. Tap and hold an album thumbnail. A sub-menu appears with two options: **Copy Link** and **Share Album**.
3. Tap **Share Album** to open the **Share Album** screen, where you can send via email or text.
4. Tap **Copy Link** to copy the album link directly to your clipboard without opening the share screen.

metadata.title: Albums > Sharing an album > Method 1: Long-press from the Albums tab

text:
Albums > Sharing an album > Method 2: From inside an album
1. Open the gallery, tap the **Albums** tab, and tap the album you want to share. The album detail screen opens.
2. Tap the **(⋯)** menu at the top of the screen. The **Copy Link** and **Share Album** options appear.
3. Tap **Share Album** to open the **Share Album** screen or tap **Copy Link** to copy the link.

Sharing via email
Available to all users.

1. Open the **Share Album** screen using either method above.
2. Tap the **Email** tab if it is not already selected.
3. The **Email** field automatically pulls in the email address from the customer or organization linked to the job.
4. Add addresses to **Cc** or **Bcc** if needed.
5. Edit the **Subject** and **Message** fields as required.
6. From the **Link expiry** list, select how long the link stays active: **7 days**, **30 days**, **90 days**, or **never expires**.
7. Tap **Send Email**.

Note:
  The link expiry is set at send time and cannot be changed afterward. If you need a longer window, open the album and share a fresh link with a new expiry.

metadata.title: Albums > Sharing an album > Method 2: From inside an album

text:
Albums > Sharing an album > Sharing via text message
Available to Zuper Connect subscribers only.

1. Open the **Share Album** screen using either method above.
2. Tap the **Text** tab.
3. The **Mobile Number** field automatically pulls in the phone number from the customer or organization linked to the job.
4. Type an optional message in the **Message** field.
5. From the **Link expiry** list, select how long the link stays active.
6. Tap **Send Text**.

Note:
  The **Text** tab is available only to Zuper Connect subscribers. If you do not see it, contact your admin to find out whether Zuper Connect is included in your organization's plan.

metadata.title: Albums > Sharing an album > Sharing via text message

text:
Albums > Copying the link
Copying a link is available to all users. You can copy it from two places:

* **From the Albums tab:** Tap and hold an album thumbnail, then tap **Copy Link** from the sub-menu.
* **From inside an album:** Tap the **(⋯)** menu at the top of the screen, then tap **Copy Link**.

Zuper copies the link to your device clipboard. Paste it into any messaging app to share it manually.

metadata.title: Albums > Copying the link

text:
Albums > Removing a photo from an album
Removing a photo from an album only removes the association with the album. The photo remains in the job gallery.

1. Open the gallery, tap the **Albums** tab, and tap the album that contains the photo.
2. Tap and hold the photo you want to remove. The bottom bar changes to show the selection count, with a **Share** icon on the left and a **Trash** icon on the right.
3. Tap the **Trash** icon.
4. Confirm the removal when prompted.

Note:
  The photo stays in the job gallery after removal. To find it, go back to the gallery and tap the **Photos** tab.

metadata.title: Albums > Removing a photo from an album

text:
Albums > Annotating album photos
You can annotate any photo inside an album the same way you annotate photos in the job gallery.

1. Open the album and tap a photo to open it in the full-screen viewer.
2. Use the annotation tools to draw, mark up, or highlight areas of the photo.
3. Save your annotations.

For full annotation steps, see [Mobile image annotations](#).

FAQs
**The Text tab does not appear when I try to share an album. Why?**

    The **Text** tab is available only to Zuper Connect subscribers. If your account does not include Zuper Connect, only the **Email** tab appears on the share screen. Contact your admin to find out whether your organization has a Zuper Connect subscription.

**Can I add photos to an album on a completed job?**

    You can add photos to albums on both active and completed jobs at any time. The job status does not affect album access.

**I do not see the Albums tab in the gallery. Why?**

    The **Albums** tab appears only when your admin has created at least one album in **Settings** > **Modules** > **Jobs** > **Gallery Settings**. Roofing accounts include six default albums. For all other account types, ask your admin to create an album so the tab becomes visible.

**Does removing a photo from an album delete it from the job?**

    The photo stays safe in the job gallery. Removing it from an album only clears the album association — nothing is deleted. You can find it again under the **Photos** tab at any time.

    If the issue continues, contact [Support](mailto:support@zuper.co).

metadata.title: Albums > Annotating album photos

text:
Photofeed
The **Photo Feed** displays all photos and videos uploaded to jobs in one place within the Zuper mobile app. Instead of opening individual jobs to view attachments, you can browse job-related media from a single screen.

All job-related photos and videos in one centralized view — no need to open individual jobs to find media attachments.

**Prerequisites**

Before using Photo Feed, ensure the following:

* The feature must be enabled by your Zuper admin (if not visible)
  \[Enable Job Gallery from Zuper Web App: In the left navigation menu, go to\_ Settings > Modules > Jobs > General Job Settings \_and turn on the **Enable Job Gallery]**
* You have access to the Zuper mobile app.
* Photos or videos have been uploaded to jobs.
* Your user role has permission to view job attachments.

metadata.title: Photofeed

text:
Photofeed > Availability — Who can use this
The Photo Feed is available on the **Zuper Mobile App**.

Typical users include:

* **Field Technicians** can upload photos and videos directly from the job site and attach them to specific jobs for documentation and recordkeeping. Each technician can only view the media they have personally uploaded.
* **Team Leads** can upload, view, and review media submitted by their team's technicians, as well as their own uploads. They use this visibility to verify work performed, monitor job progress, and ensure quality standards are met.
* **Admins** have full visibility into all media submitted across the organization. They can access and review attachments across all jobs for auditing and compliance purposes.

metadata.title: Photofeed > Availability — Who can use this

text:
Photofeed > Access Photo Feed
1. Open the “**Photo Feed**” from the Dashboard.

Photo Feed tabs
Below the Photo Feed title, two tabs allow you to change how media is displayed.

1. Photos (Default) tab
* Displays all photos and videos in a **grid layout** for quick browsing.

By default, the Photos section displays media in a grid layout.

Key behaviors include:

* Media is sorted by upload date (newest first).
* The grid displays 3, 4, or 6 images per row, which can be adjusted in the top-right corner.
* Both images and videos appear in the feed.
* Videos display a play icon in their thumbnails.

To view a media item:

1. Tap any photo or video thumbnail.
2. The media opens to the **full-screen media viewer**.

metadata.title: Photofeed > Access Photo Feed

text:
Photofeed > 1. Photos (Default) tab > Using filters in Photo Feed
Filters let you narrow the media displayed in the feed.

**Apply filters**

1. Open **Photo Feed**.
2. Tap a filter option.
3. Select the required values.
4. Tap **Apply**.

| **Filter** | **Description** |
| :- | :- |
| **Media Type** | Filter media based on attachment type. |
| **Tags** | Filter attachments using tags assigned to images or videos. |
| **Date Range** | Filter media uploaded within a specific timeframe or a custom date range. |
| **Uploaded By** | Filter media by the user who uploaded the attachment.    **Note**: The uploaded by option is available only for the Admin and Team Leader. |

metadata.title: Photofeed > 1. Photos (Default) tab > Using filters in Photo Feed

text:
Photofeed > 1. Photos (Default) tab > View media on full screen
When you tap a photo or video, the **Media Viewer** opens in full-screen mode.

**Available actions include:**

* Swipe left or right to move between media items.
* View media in a carousel sequence.
* Zoom in on images for closer inspection.

**Tags**

Displays tags assigned to the attachment. Depending on permissions, you may be able to:

* **Add tags**
* **Remove tags**
* Displays the attachment **description** if one exists.
* Image [**Annotation**](https://zuperinc-section23.mintlify.app/Zuper_Mobile_Apps/Mobile-image-annotations) can be done.

A navigation indicator at the top shows your position in the media sequence. You can “**Rename**” or “**Share**” the file.

**User information**

The top section displays information about the user who uploaded the image, including their name, the file name, and the date and time of upload.

metadata.title: Photofeed > 1. Photos (Default) tab > View media on full screen

text:
Photofeed > 2. Jobs tab
The **Photo Feed** screen opens and displays media from all jobs.

* Displays media grouped by job present in the format of cards, showing only jobs with a scheduled date, allowing you to review attachments associated with a specific job.
* The date range filter includes Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last month, and Custom date range.
* Tapping **More** opens the Job’s Gallery.
* Use the **Camera** icon to capture pictures.
* To return to the Jobs tab, tap the **Back** button within the Job Gallery

metadata.title: Photofeed > 2. Jobs tab

text:
Photofeed > Troubleshooting geo-tag discrepancies > Check location permissions
The Zuper app requires location access to accurately geo-tag photos. Verify the permission is set correctly on your device.

**On iOS:**

1. Open **Settings** on your iPhone.
2. Scroll down and tap **Zuper**.
3. Tap **Location**.
4. Select **While Using the App** or **Always**.
5. Ensure **Precise Location** is toggled on.

**On Android:**

1. Open **Settings** on your device.
2. Tap **Apps** → **Zuper**.
3. Tap **Permissions** → **Location**.
4. Select **Allow only while using the app** or **Allow all the time**.
5. Ensure **Use precise location** is enabled if shown.

> **Note:** Selecting "Only this time" or "Deny" will prevent Zuper from reading your GPS, causing photos to be tagged inaccurately or not at all.

***

metadata.title: Photofeed > Troubleshooting geo-tag discrepancies > Check location permissions

text:
Photofeed > Troubleshooting geo-tag discrepancies > Allow GPS to lock before capturing
After arriving at the job site, wait a few seconds before taking photos. This gives the device time to acquire an accurate GPS fix. You can confirm your location is accurate by checking the map pin on the job details screen before uploading.

Field teams generate a constant stream of job photos and videos, but without a central view, that media stays buried inside individual job records. Photo Feed brings it all to the surface.

metadata.title: Photofeed > Troubleshooting geo-tag discrepancies > Allow GPS to lock before capturing

text:
Annotating Images
Zuper's Mobile Image Annotations feature lets you easily mark up photos right in the app. It's perfect for field teams like roofers, inspectors, or technicians who need to highlight issues, show progress, or add notes to job photos. No more switching to other apps, everything happens seamlessly in Zuper.

This tool helps create clear, standardized visuals for better communication, whether you're noting roof damage during an inspection or marking completion in post-job docs.

metadata.title: Annotating Images

text:
Annotating Images > Getting started
1. **Access Annotations**: Open a job in Zuper. Go to the **Gallery** tab to view or upload images. Select an image, then tap the “**Annotation**” icon to enter annotation mode.

2. **Interface Overview**: You'll see the image on a canvas with a toolbar at the bottom. Tools include drawing, shapes, text, stickers, and more. At the top, there's a navigation bar with options like Undo, Redo, Save, and Close (X).
3. **Editing Basics**: Use your finger to draw or place elements. Selected tools include color pickers, opacity/stroke sliders, and input fields.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Getting started

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 1. Freehand drawing tool
The toolbar provides intuitive markup tools. Icons are simple and discoverable. Here's a breakdown of each, with tips based on common uses:

1. Freehand drawing tool
* **Icon**: Pencil or squiggly line.
* **What it does**: Draw freehand lines in a range of available colors.
* **Options**: Color palettes include a variety of colors.
* **Tips**: Use for quick highlights, like circling damage on a roof.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 1. Freehand drawing tool

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 2. Polyline tool
* **Icon**: Connected line segments.
* **What it does**: Draw a series of connected straight line segments to form custom paths or outlines.
* **Options**: Choose a color.
* **Tips**: Ideal for tracing irregular boundaries, like outlining a building perimeter or creating a custom fence line.

3. Arrow/Line tool
* **Icon**: Diagonal arrow, line, or double arrow line.
* **What it does**: Draw straight to point out specifics.
* **Tips**: Ideal for directing attention, like arrowing to a roof section.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 2. Polyline tool

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 4. Text tool
* **Icon**: "**T**".
* **What it does**: Add editable text boxes.
* **Options**: Type in the pop-up, and it can be resized using freehand.
* Switch between **Text** and **Measurement** modes for labels or dimensions.
* **Tips**: Place text like "**Roof**" above a house image. Tap "**Okay**" to apply; edit later by selecting. Useful for status notes or timestamps.

**Measurement Mode:**

* Switch to the input dimensions tab. Supports units like:
* [ft.in](http://ft.in) (feet and inches), [m.cm](http://m.cm) (meters and centimeters).
* sq.ft (square feet).

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 4. Text tool

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 5. Magnifier Tool
* **Icon:** Magnifying glass.
* **What it does:** Zooms in on a specific area of the image to highlight small details.
* **Options:** Adjust magnification level and reposition the zoom area.
* **Tips:** Use the magnifier to clearly show small damage points, nail pops, or roof surface details.

Note:
  **Note**: The Magnifier is currently available for Android.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 5. Magnifier Tool

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 6. Shape Tools
* **Circle/Ellipse Tool**
  * **Icon**: Circle outline.
  * **What it does**: Draw circles or ovals to enclose areas.
  * **Options**: Modify colors.
  * **Tips**: Circle roof vents or damage spots.

**Square/Rectangle Tool**

* **Icon**: Square outline.
* **What it does**: Create boxes for highlighting sections.
* **Options**: You can modify the color.
* **Tips**: Box in areas like siding or windows to focus on.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 6. Shape Tools

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 7. Sticker Tool
* **Icon**: Arc or emoji-like shape.
* **What it does**: Adds stickers from the list for quick status or labels.
* **Tips**: Tap to place. Resize or rotate. Perfect for standardized updates, like marking job progress on a house photo.

8. Rotate Tool
* **Icon**: Circular arrow (for rotation) – This will be available after choosing the crop button.
* **What it does**: Rotate the entire image or selected annotations.
* **Options**: Slider from -10° to +10° (centered at 0.0°). Tap Apply or Cancel.
* **Tips**: Fine-tune angles for better alignment. Useful if the photo was taken sideways.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 7. Sticker Tool

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 9. Crop Tool
* **Icon**: Crop frame.
* **What it does**: Trim the image boundaries. The image's angle of orientation can be modified.
* **Options**: Drag handles to adjust; confirm or cancel.
* **Tips**: Focus on key areas, like zooming in on the roof.

**Saving or Discarding**: Tap **Save** to keep changes. If you try to exit with unsaved edits, a dialog box asks: "Discard changes? You have unsaved annotations. Are you sure you want to discard them?" Choose **Keep editing** or **Discard**.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > 9. Crop Tool

text:
Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > Best Practices
* **Standardize Annotations**: Use stickers for consistency.
* **Collaboration**: Share annotated images directly for team reviews.

The **Mobile Image Annotations** feature allows technicians to add notes or markings to photos directly in the Zuper mobile app. This helps document job details clearly and keeps annotated images saved within the job record for future reference.

metadata.title: Annotating Images > Annotation toolbar tools > Best Practices

metadata.title: Non-Job Events

text:
Non-Job Events > Overview
Not every part of your workday is tied to a job. When you have a team meeting, a training session, or an administrative task to log, you can create a non-job event directly from your Zuper mobile app.

Before you start
* Ensure that ‘**Can Field Technicians create new non-job events**?‘ is enabled under Job General Settings -> Access/Permissions by the admin.
* Creating recurring non-job events is not supported on the mobile app.

metadata.title: Non-Job Events > Overview

text:
Non-Job Events > Create the event
1. Go to your **Dashboard**.
2. Tap the **+** button in the **Quick Links** section.
3. Select **New Non-Job Events** from the list.
4. The **New Non-Job Event** screen opens.
5. Fill in the required fields in the **Non-Job Event Details** section:
   * **Event Name** — Type a short and clear name.
   * **Category** — From the **Category** list, select the category that matches the type of event.
   * **Event Description** — Specify any additional context about the event. By default, Zuper fills this field automatically based on the category you selected. You can modify it or add a new description.
   * **Attendees** — Assign one or more FEs who will participate in this event. (As a field executive, you can add only yourself as an attendee.)
6. Specify the location:
   * **Event Address** — Provide the location of the event by picking it from the map. Set the schedule:
   * To schedule the event for the full day, turn on the **All-day** toggle. Zuper hides the **Start time** and **End time** fields.
7. To schedule the event for a specific time:
   * In the **Schedule On** field, select the event date.
   * In the **Start time** field, set the event start time.
   * In the **End time** field, set the event end time. If your organization uses multiple time zones, select a **Preferred time zone**. This option is available only if time zone switching is enabled.
8. Complete the **Additional Settings** section: **Availability** — This applies to all event attendees.
   Tap **Busy** if attendees are unavailable during this event, or **Free** if attendees are available. When you set availability to **Busy**, Zuper blocks this time slot in Assisted Scheduling.
9. **Notify attendees** — Mark this checkbox to send a push notification to all attendees regarding the event. Tap **Create** to save the non-job event.

Tap **Create** to save the non-job event.

<video src="https://mintcdn.com/zuperinc/EHcTPcnhk_MxkOSl/videos/Non_Job_Event.mp4?fit=max&auto=format&n=EHcTPcnhk_MxkOSl&q=85&s=d2f36308f003c30b5317fac5bf43f465" controls data-path="videos/Non_Job_Event.mp4" />

Tap the context menu on the event details to edit or delete it.

Note:
  Note: If you or other attendees (if you are a Team Lead or Admin) have an event, job, or time off scheduled at the same time, Zuper displays a **Confirm schedule** warning. You can still create the event if needed or modify the schedule timings

metadata.title: Non-Job Events > Create the event

text:
Non-Job Events > FAQs
1. **What should I do if I see a conflict warning after creating an event?**
   You see a conflict warning when the event overlaps with a busy event, a time-off request, or an existing job on your schedule. Open your schedule in **Day View** to identify the overlap. Adjust the start or end time of the event to resolve the conflict.
   A TL and Admin can view all employees with conflicts, while FE, when scheduling non-job events, can see their conflict alerts and adjust their schedule accordingly.
2. **Why did attendees not receive a notification for my event?**
   Confirm that the **Notify Attendees** checkbox was selected before you created the event. The Zuper mobile app sends push notifications to attendees' devices. Ask attendees to confirm that push notifications are enabled on their devices.
3. **Can I assign additional attendees to a non-job event?**
   As a field executive, you can create a non-job event for yourself only. Zuper automatically adds you as the sole attendee. You cannot assign other attendees to the event. Your team lead can assign themselves or any member of your team. Your admin can assign any user.
   If the issue continues, contact [Support](mailto:support@zuper.co).

***

metadata.title: Non-Job Events > FAQs

text:
Quickstart Guide
> This guide provides field technicians with essential steps to navigate and use the Zuper Mobile App efficiently.

Overview
The Zuper Mobile App is designed to help Field Executives efficiently manage their daily field operations. With a streamlined interface and quick access to essential job information, the app enables you to:

* View and manage assigned jobs
* Update job status in real-time
* Complete service tasks and checklists
* Communicate with customers and your internal team
* Add notes, upload photos/videos, and log activities

The mobile app ensures that every FE stays informed, organized, and productive throughout the workday.

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide

text:
Quickstart Guide > Downloading and Installing the Zuper Field Service App
1. Open the **Google Play Store** (Android) or **App Store** (iOS) on your mobile device.
2. In the search bar, type **“Zuper- Field Service App.”**
3. From the search results, select the Zuper app.
4. Tap **Install** (Android) or **Get** (iOS).

5. Once installed, tap **Open** or click the **Zuper** app icon on your home screen to begin using the app.

Quickstart Guide > Job Management > Adding Job Notes
The **Notes** feature allows you to capture, upload, and manage various types of content in real time. You can add photos, videos, audio, documents, text, and scanned files directly to a note.

**Capturing Content**

1. **Photo**
   * Tap the **Add note**  icon from the quick actions bar.
   * By default, you’ll land in the **Photos** section.
   * Capture a photo using the camera in **0.6x** or **1.0x** size. Multiple photos can be captured in one session.

2. **Video**
   * Switch to Video mode in the Notes section.
   * Record your video and attach it to the note once you are satisfied.

3. **Audio**
   * Use the Audio option to record and upload audio directly to the note.
   * You can retake the recording or save it once satisfied.

4. **Document**
   * Use the Document option to upload or attach relevant documents from your device.

5. **Text**
   * Enter or edit text directly in the note using the text option.

6. **Scan**
   * Go to the Scan option to capture and upload digital versions of physical documents.
   * You can crop the edges of scanned documents, if needed.

7. **Walkthrough**
   * This option allows you to capture images and record voice input simultaneously during a job.
   * Zuper AI then transcribes and summarizes the spoken content, combining it with the captured images to automatically generate a clear and structured job note.

For more information on using the AI Walkthrough Note, check out this [article](https://docs.zuper.co/Zuper_AI/AI_walkthrough_note).

  **Tips & Guidelines**

text:
Quickstart Guide > Job Management > Offline upload
If your device is offline when you upload a file, the upload is saved locally on your device and queued for sync. However, if the app closes or your device restarts before a connection is restored, that upload might not persist. Always confirm a successful sync using the **Activity (Jobs → Job Details Page → Context Menu → Activity)** log before leaving a job site.

**Offline **

  #### How uploads work

  When you upload a document or image on the mobile app:

  * The file is queued on your device immediately.
  * The app syncs the file to Zuper as soon as an internet connection is available.
  * A sync indicator appears on the upload thumbnail until the file has successfully uploaded.
  * Once synced, the file appears in the job's **Notes** tab or **Gallery** tab and is visible to your team.

  > **Important:** Uploads queued while offline might not persist if the app is force-closed or your device restarts before a connection is restored. Upload files while connected whenever possible.

  #### **Upload a document or image to a job note**

  1. Tap the job you want to update from your assigned jobs list.
  2. Tap the **Add note** icon from the quick actions bar.
  3. From the **Document** list, select the file type that matches what you want to upload — for example, **Document** for a PDF or **Photo** for an image.
  4. Select the file from your device or capture a new photo.
  5. Type a description in the note field if needed.
  6. Tap **Post Note** to save and queue the upload.

  > **Tip:** You can attach up to five files per note. Each file must be 20 MB or smaller. Supported file types include images, videos, audio, PDF, Docs, Excel, archives, and other standard file formats.

  #### Check if your upload synced successfully

  After uploading a file, confirm it synced before you leave the job site.

  1. Tap the job the file was uploaded to.
  2. Swipe to the **Activity** tab on the job details page.
  3. Look for an upload event entry that matches the file name and timestamp.
  4. If the entry appears, the file has synced successfully.

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Job Management > Offline upload

text:
Quickstart Guide > Job Management > Offline upload
> **Note:** If you uploaded the file while offline, the **Activity** log entry appears only after your device reconnects and the sync completes. Wait for a connection and then check the log again.

  #### What to do if you are offline when you upload

  If you know you are in an area with no or poor connectivity:

  1. Complete the upload steps as normal — the file is queued on your device.
  2. Keep the app open and in the foreground until you regain a connection.
  3. Once your device shows a connection, wait for the sync indicator on the upload thumbnail to disappear.
  4. Go to the **Activity** tab on the job to confirm the upload event appears.

  > **Tip:** Do not force-close the app or restart your device while files are waiting to sync. Doing so might cause queued uploads to be lost.

**Adding and Associating Notes**

After capturing content, you’ll be redirected to the **Add note** section. Here you can:

* Add description, upload additional photos, videos, documents, or other files from your device under **Attachments**
* Associate the note with other modules, such as projects, contacts, organizations, properties, and more, under **Associated with.**

Once ready, click **Submit** to finalize the note.

**Managing Notes**

Submitted notes appear in the **Notes** section of the job. You can:

1. Filter notes from **latest to oldest**

2. Use the **kebab icon (****)** to perform actions, including:
   * **Edit Note**   – Modify the note’s content and add or remove attachments
   * **Pin Note** – Keep important notes at the top
   * **Change Note Privacy**:
     1. **Private** – Visible only to the note creator
     2. **Backoffice Only** – Visible to Admins and Team Leads
     3. **Public** – Accessible to all users and the contact
   * **Delete** – Remove the note from the associated module

text:
Quickstart Guide > Using the App in Offline Mode
The Zuper Mobile App supports an **Offline Mode**- allowing you to keep working even in areas with limited or no internet connectivity.

**Enabling Offline Mode**

* The offline feature must first be enabled for your organization via the Zuper Admin portal.
* Once enabled, you can turn on offline mode from the **Settings**>>**Configuration**>>**Offline Mode**.

* After switching on offline mode and when the necessary data is downloaded, the app status will show as **“Ready for offline usage.”**

**What Data is Available Offline**

When offline is enabled and primed, the app stores local copies of all relevant records tied to the user’s assigned jobs (for a window around ±3 days). This includes: job details, related customers/organizations, assets, properties, contracts, parts & services, and routes for assigned work.

However, note that some modules are **not** primed offline — for example, quotes, invoices, and other unrelated records.

**What You Can Do Offline**

While offline, you can

* View assigned jobs and job details (with keyword search for those jobs)
* Update job status and checklists (including uploading pictures as part of the checklist)
* Add job notes and attachments (photos/videos/documents) tied to a job.
* View and manage service tasks assigned to jobs — including viewing associated assets, filling inspection forms, viewing submitted forms, and updating task status. If a service task was unassigned, updating it offline will auto-assign it to the technician who updated it.
* View cached data about customers, assets, organizations, properties, parts & services relevant to their assigned jobs.

Once your device reconnects to the internet, all offline changes (status updates, notes, checklist completions, service-task updates) are queued and automatically synced with the backend. The app dashboard shows the upload status to help you track pending syncs.

**⚠️ Limitations & Considerations**

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Using the App in Offline Mode

text:
Quickstart Guide > Using the App in Offline Mode
* Only records linked to jobs assigned to the user are primed offline. Even if a user is an Admin or Team Lead, jobs not assigned to them are **not** available offline.
* Only up to 2 levels of associated records are primed. For example, jobs → customers → organizations/assets; but deeper linked records or unrelated modules are not available offline.
* Some features are **not** supported offline: e.g., accepting or rejecting new job assignments must be done online.
* Modules such as chat, notifications, and real-time updates do not work offline.

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Using the App in Offline Mode

text:
Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature
The SOS feature in the Zuper Mobile App enables you to quickly alert your organization during emergencies. When triggered, the system automatically captures your current location and sends an SMS notification to the configured emergency contact, ensuring timely assistance.

**Enabling the SOS Shortcut**

Before using SOS, ensure the feature is enabled in your app settings.

1. Go to **Settings** in the Zuper Mobile App.

2. Under **Configuration**, toggle the **SOS Shortcut** on.
3. Once toggled on, the **SOS icon** will appear on the mobile device for quick access.

**Triggering an SOS Alert**

In case of an emergency, you can quickly raise an alert:

1. **Double-tap** the SOS icon displayed over the app.
2. The app automatically captures your **current GPS location**.
3. An SMS alert is sent to the emergency phone number configured by your organization. The message includes your name, phone number, and exact location with a clickable link.

This helps your team respond promptly and accurately.

**Note**

* SOS will be available only if your **organization has enabled this feature**.
* SMS delivery depends on your mobile network availability.
* The SOS icon will appear only after you enable the **SOS shortcut** under **Settings → Configuration**.

***

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature

text:
Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Understanding in-app network indicators
When the Zuper app detects connectivity issues, it surfaces indicators rather than crashing or showing blank screens. Here is what each one means:

| Indicator | What it means | What to do |
| :- | :- | :- |
| **"Poor connection. Showing saved jobs only."** | The app is serving cached data. Live sync is unavailable. | Check your network connection. If you are in an area with low signal, this is expected. See Using Zuper Offline for how cached data works. |
| **"Last refreshed \[time]"** | A record has not synced recently due to poor signal. | Move to a stronger network and pull to refresh the record. |
| **"Showing limited details"** | The app could not load the complete record due to a weak connection. | Retry on a stronger network. |
| **"Unable to load latest updates"** | The record is outdated and the app cannot refresh it. | Check your connection and try again. If offline mode is enabled, the record may be serving cached data from a previous session. |

If you are not seeing any of these indicators but are still getting errors, continue to the steps below.

***

Troubleshooting network errors on the Zuper mobile app

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Understanding in-app network indicators

text:
Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Step 1: Basic checks
Run these first regardless of the device or network:

1. Open a browser on the affected device and visit any website. If it does not load, the network itself is the issue — not Zuper.
2. Force-close the Zuper app completely and reopen it.
3. Toggle Wi-Fi off, wait ten seconds, and toggle it back on.
4. If you are in an area with a weak signal, move closer to the router or switch to cellular and retry.
5. Log out of the Zuper app and log back in. This restarts the data priming process.

Note:  When you log in, the Zuper app automatically downloads job data for your assigned jobs (data priming). If a network error occurs during priming, an error message appears and priming stops. Logging out and back in on a stable connection restarts this process.

If the issue only affects one device while another device on the same network works fine, continue to Step 2.

***

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Step 1: Basic checks

text:
Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Step 2: Device-specific diagnosis > App and OS version
When one device shows errors and another on the same Wi-Fi network does not, the root cause is almost always a device-level setting. Work through the following:

App and OS version
| Check | Steps |
| :- | :- |
| **App version mismatch** | Open the App Store (iOS) or Play Store (Android) on the affected device. Check whether a Zuper update is available and install it. Confirm both devices are on the same version. |
| **Outdated OS** | Go to Settings → General → Software Update. Install any pending updates. |

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Step 2: Device-specific diagnosis > App and OS version

text:
Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Network and connectivity settings
**Wi-Fi Assist**

    **What it does:** When Wi-Fi is weak, the device automatically switches to cellular data. This can cause Zuper to drop and re-establish its connection intermittently, producing network errors even when Wi-Fi appears connected.

    **Note:** Wi-Fi Assist is only available on cellular-capable iPads. If the affected iPad is a Wi-Fi-only model, skip this check.

    1. Open **Settings**.
    2. Tap **Cellular** (or **Mobile Data**, depending on your region).
    3. Scroll to the bottom of the screen.
    4. Toggle **Wi-Fi Assist** off.
    5. Reopen Zuper and retest.

**Background App Refresh**

    **What it does:** Controls whether Zuper can sync data in the background when you switch to another app. If disabled, the app stops updating until you reopen it, which can cause stale or missing data on return.

    1. Open **Settings**.
    2. Tap **General**.
    3. Tap **Background App Refresh**.
    4. At the top, confirm the master toggle is set to **Wi-Fi** or **Wi-Fi & Cellular Data** — not **Off**.
    5. Scroll down to **Zuper** and confirm its individual toggle is on.
    6. Reopen Zuper and retest.

Note:
      Background App Refresh is automatically disabled when Low Power Mode is active. If the affected device is in Low Power Mode, disable it under **Settings → Battery** and retest.

**VPN active on one device**

    **What it does:** A VPN running on the affected device but not the other may route traffic differently or block certain Zuper endpoints, causing intermittent errors that appear network-related.

    1. Open **Settings**.
    2. Tap **General**.
    3. Tap **VPN & Device Management**.
    4. Under **VPN**, check whether a VPN configuration is listed and connected.
    5. If a VPN is active, disconnect it temporarily and retest Zuper.
    6. If the error disappears, contact your IT administrator — the VPN profile may need a Zuper-specific exception.

Note:
      On MDM-managed iPads, a VPN profile may be enforced by your organization and cannot be disabled from the device. In that case, escalate to your IT administrator with the Zuper error details and the screen recording.

metadata.title: Quickstart Guide > Using the SOS Feature > Network and connectivity settings

text:
Tasks
Creating a Task on the Zuper mobile app is easy. Tasks can be used to schedule internal activities or follow-ups that do not require creating a formal service job. You can create tasks as standalone items or associate them with a job or project.

Tasks can be created from the following places in the Zuper mobile:

* From the **Dashboard**, tap **My Tasks** in Quick Links → tap the **+** icon (bottom right). 

* From the **Dashboard**, tap the quick create **+** icon → select **New Task**.

* From a **Job/Project detail** screen → go to the **Tasks** tab → tap **+** icon.

metadata.title: Tasks

text:
Tasks > Creating a task
From the new task screen, you will be prompted to enter:

* Enter your task with a clear, descriptive **title**.
* Give your Task a **description**.
* Set the task **due date.**
* Choose a **task type** from the list. By default, the “*Task*” as a type will be filled in. You can choose to modify if required.
* Select a **priority** level.
* **Assign** the task to yourself or to a team member.

Note:
    **Note**: If you’re logged in as a Field Executive, the task is automatically assigned to you.

* Tap the **+** icon for additional options:
  * **Set Reminder**: Schedule reminders to help the assignee act on time. This option appears only after a **Due Date** is set in the task. The assignee will receive the push notification on their device.
  * **Associated Module:** Link to a Job or Project (auto-linked if created from a Job/Project). Linked tasks also appear in the Job/Project's **Tasks** tab.
  * **Inspection form**: Attach a form that must be completed before closing the task.
  * **Attachments**: Upload relevant files or documents to support the task with additional context or details.

After entering all the required details, click “**Create**”. The assigned user receives a push notification for the assignment.

Tip:
  **Tips**: To save time, create tasks using templates. Tap on the  icon to search and choose the relevant task from the master list. The selected master task will automatically pre-fill the details on the creation page.

text:
Using Zuper Offline > Offline Support
When the Zuper mobile app is connected to the Internet, it regularly synchronizes your data with the Zuper backend services to ensure that your data is always up to date. If the app is offline, users will see a message within the app indicating that data was loaded from an offline source. Zuper supports Offline Mode, allowing technicians to work in areas with poor connectivity or when they are completely offline.

When the app serves local data for an extended period, users will see an indicator that the information may be outdated.

metadata.title: Using Zuper Offline > Offline Support

text:
Using Zuper Offline > How to turn on offline capability?
The customer must request that the Zuper team enable the offline feature for their account. Our Zuper team can enable the offline feature for the company.

Once the offline feature has been enabled, the users of that company can find the offline settings under the '**configuration**' section on the in-app settings page. Users who require offline mode can enable it in their accounts as a one-time setup

Once offline mode is enabled and the required data has been downloaded, the app will display the status "**Ready for offline usage.**"

1. Go to app settings.

2. Open offline mode settings.

3. Enable “**Cache data for offline usage**” feature.

metadata.title: Using Zuper Offline > How to turn on offline capability?

text:
Using Zuper Offline > How does the data get synced?
When a user logs in to the Zuper app, the app automatically downloads data for the **user’s assigned jobs**. This process is referred to as Data priming, and it ensures that all the data that a field technician needs is available even if internet connectivity is lost. If there's a large volume of data, the priming process can take some time after the initial app launch or after a user logs in. If a network error occurs during priming, an error message will appear, and priming will stop.

metadata.title: Using Zuper Offline > How does the data get synced?

text:
Using Zuper Offline > What data will be available offline?
The app primes data for each field technician based on the user’s assigned jobs. Additionally, any records the user accesses while online are cached and available offline for a couple of days, regardless of their role

Related records are primed to a depth of 2, except as detailed in the table below.

| Module | What Gets Primed |
| - | - |
| **Jobs** | All primary job information and associated records (customer, organization, assets, property, parts & services) within a ±3 day window. Only jobs assigned to the user are primed. |
| **Routes** | Routes of the jobs assigned to the user are cached offline. |
| **Customers** | Customers linked to the assigned jobs are cached. |
| **Organizations** | Organizations linked to the assigned jobs are cached. |
| **Properties** | Properties linked to the assigned jobs are cached. |
| **Assets** | Assets belonging to the customers of assigned jobs are cached. |
| **Contracts** | Contracts linked to the assigned jobs are cached. |
| **Parts & Services** | Parts and services linked to the assigned jobs are cached. |
| **Quotes & Invoices** | Not supported. |

Note:
  **Note:** For the Team Leader role, all jobs assigned to them and their team members are cached. For admin roles, only jobs directly assigned to them are cached

metadata.title: Using Zuper Offline > What data will be available offline?

text:
Using Zuper Offline > What actions can be done offline?
Zuper app currently supports only the following actions to be performed offline.

| Module | Supported Actions |
| - | - |
| **Jobs** | - View job details. - Update job status and checklist (including attachments). - Update job timer/timelog. - View and add job notes (including attachments). - Access job gallery and add attachments. |
| **Jobs → Service Tasks** | - a. View service tasks and details. - b. Submit / Edit inspection form. - c. Update service task status. |
| **Routes** | View route detail and timeline on the dashboard |
| **Customers** | View primary details |
| **Organizations** | View primary details |
| **Properties** | View primary details |
| **Assets** | View primary details |
| **Contracts** | View primary details |
| **Parts & Services** | View primary details |

* All the above-mentioned supported actions occur in the background by default (the user doesn't have to wait for the upload to complete), regardless of the user's online or offline status or network connection quality. However, this process only takes place if offline mode is enabled for the user.

metadata.title: Using Zuper Offline > What actions can be done offline?

text:
Using Zuper Offline > What actions can be done offline? > Considerations for Offline Support:
* Only 2 levels of associated records are primed offline. For example, customers linked to Jobs are primed, but customer cards and payment transactions are not primed
* Offline data is primed locally for a maximum of 1 day, post which it is automatically
  invalidated.

How do I know if I see an offline or outdated record?
* The app displays a *"***Poor connection. Showing saved jobs only***"* indicator when all listing pages/screens are showing data from cache only.

* Displays a *"***Last refreshed***"* indicator when a user accesses a record for an extended period under poor network conditions

* Displays a "**Showing limited details**" indicator when the connection is poor, and the app is unable to load the complete record data.

* Displays an **"Unable to load latest updates"** indicator when a record is outdated, and the app cannot refresh the latest information due to poor connectivity.

metadata.title: Using Zuper Offline > What actions can be done offline? > Considerations for Offline Support:

text:
Using Zuper Offline > What actions can be done offline? > How do I see status of my updates/uploads?
* Real-time progress of updates and uploads is displayed on both the dashboard and individual record pages.

Limitations
* Job Accept/Reject can't be done offline. Technicians have to accept their respective jobs before going offline.
* File attachments such as images already added in notes, checklists, custom fields, etc, are not cached offline.
* Chat messages & notifications does not work offline.

metadata.title: Using Zuper Offline > What actions can be done offline? > How do I see status of my updates/uploads?

text:
AI Field Agent
Field Agent is Zuper's built-in voice AI for job checklists.

When you update a job status and a checklist appears, you can launch Field Agent instead of filling out each field manually. Speak naturally, the way you'd explain the job to a colleague. Field Agent listens, understands your response, and maps every answer to the right field automatically. Your entries are saved as a draft throughout the session, so nothing's lost if you get interrupted.

Note:
  **Note**: Field Agent is currently in Beta. We recommend reviewing your captured answers before submitting.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent

text:
AI Field Agent > Before you begin
* Ensure the Field Agent feature is enabled for your account. If it isn't, contact [support@zuper.co](mailto:support@zuper.co) to have it enabled.
* Grant the Zuper mobile app permission to access your microphone and camera. Field Agent requires both permissions to work.
* Field Agent works with single-page checklists only. If your checklist has multiple pages, you must complete it manually.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > Before you begin

text:
AI Field Agent > Launching Field Agent
Field Agent is available when a checklist appears during a job status update.

1. When the checklist screen appears, locate the **Field Agent** icon in the bottom-right corner of the screen.

2. Tap the icon. The Voice Mode panel slides up.
3. Field Agent begins guiding you through the checklist questions one by one.

Answering checklist questions
Once Field Agent is initialised, it reads each question and waits for your spoken response. You don't need to tap any field. Field Agent captures your answer and fills it in automatically.

1. Listen to the question. Field Agent may group related questions together and ask you to answer them at the same time.
2. Speak your answer clearly. The status bar at the bottom shows **Listening** when Field Agent is ready to capture your voice.
3. Your spoken answer appears in a speech bubble on screen. Field Agent processes it and populates the relevant checklist field.
4. The progress counter at the top - for example, **3/4 answered** - updates after each answer is accepted.
5. Field Agent moves on to the next question automatically.

You can answer one question at a time or cover several in a single response. Field Agent is smart enough to map each answer to the right field.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > Launching Field Agent

text:
AI Field Agent > What can Field Agent handle?
Field Agent supports most checklist field types, making it easy to capture information using voice.

**Supported field types:**

* Yes / No questions
* Short text answers
* Multiple choice options
* Numbers (such as quantities or measurements)
* Photos
* Product Lookup

Note:
  **Note**: Field Agent doesn't support file uploads, signatures, tables, barcodes, video, walkthrough video, or custom field dependencies. Complete these fields manually on the checklist form after your session.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > What can Field Agent handle?

text:
AI Field Agent > How Product Lookup works
When the checklist includes a Product Lookup field, speak the name of the part or product. Field Agent searches your inventory, reads back the matches it found along with pricing, and waits for you to confirm which item you want and how many units. Once you confirm, Field Agent fills in the product name, SKU, quantity, and price automatically.

Note:
  **Note**: Product Lookup is the only lookup type Field Agent supports. User, Asset, and Quote lookups aren't supported and must be filled in manually.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > How Product Lookup works

text:
AI Field Agent > How photo fields work
Photo questions are grouped toward the end of your session. Field Agent opens the camera when it's time to capture each photo. Take the shot and Field Agent confirms it's saved before moving on.

If your checklist has multiple photo fields, Field Agent works through them one by one. You don't have to complete all of them in one go. At any point, you can tell Field Agent to go back to the checklist questions and return to the remaining photos later.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > How photo fields work

text:
AI Field Agent > Controls during your session
You have quick controls on the Voice Mode panel at all times.

| Control | Icon | What it does |
| - | - | - |
| **Checklist icon** |  | Switches to a structured view showing all answered and unanswered fields |
| **Camera icon** |  | Opens your device's camera to capture a photo |
| **Microphone icon** |  | Mutes or unmutes your microphone |

Tip:
  **Tip**: You can tap the **X** in the top-left corner at any time to close Field Agent. Your progress is automatically saved as a draft, so no answers are lost. You can reopen Field Agent anytime to continue from where you left off.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > Controls during your session

text:
AI Field Agent > Prefer to answer by looking at the questions?
Tap the **Checklist icon** at any time during your session. This switches you to a structured view of all the checklist fields, answered and unanswered. With your captured answers already filled in. You can read through the questions at your own pace and fill in any remaining fields directly, without waiting for the Field Agent to read them out.

This is useful when you'd rather review the full checklist visually or complete a few fields manually without interrupting the voice session.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > Prefer to answer by looking at the questions?

text:
AI Field Agent > Reviewing and submitting
When you've finished answering all the questions:

1. Tap the **Checklist icon** to review all captured answers.
2. Complete any unsupported fields manually.
3. Tap **Submit** when you're ready.

Your job status updates automatically once the checklist is submitted.

Note:
  Always review your answers before submitting. Field Agent is AI-powered and may occasionally make mistakes.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > Reviewing and submitting

text:
AI Field Agent > FAQs
**Does Field Agent work for all checklists?**

    No. Field Agent works with single-page checklists only. If your checklist has multiple pages, you must complete it manually.

**Do I have to wait for each question to finish before I answer?**

    No. You can speak freely and cover multiple questions at once. Field Agent understands natural language and maps each answer to the correct field automatically.

**What lookup types does Field Agent support?**

    Product Lookup only. User, Asset, and Quote lookups aren't supported and must be filled in manually on the checklist form.

**What if Field Agent captures an answer incorrectly?**

    Tap the Checklist icon to review your answers, correct any field manually, and submit when you're ready.

**What happens if I close Field Agent before submitting?**

    Your answers are saved as a draft. Your job status won't update until you submit the completed checklist.

metadata.title: AI Field Agent > FAQs

> Store, view, and manage all photos and videos linked to a customer or contact from the Zuper mobile app.

The customer/contact gallery gives you one place to view every photo and video linked to a customer or contact. You no longer need to search through notes or job records for a specific image.

text:

2. Tap **More** from the bottom navigation bar.

4. Type the customer or contact's name in the **Search customers** bar, or scroll to find the record.
5. Tap the customer or contact to open the details page.

7. Tap **Gallery** from the menu. The gallery opens, showing all media uploaded for this customer or contact.

metadata.title: Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > Access the gallery

text:
Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > View media
The gallery displays all photos and videos grouped by upload date. Each item shows a thumbnail, with a date label above each group.

**Open a file in full-screen view**

1. Tap any photo or video thumbnail. The file opens in full-screen view.
2. Review the file details in the header: the uploader's name, the file name, and the upload date and time.
3. Tap an action icon at the bottom of the screen to edit, tag, remove, or comment on the file.

**Rename a file**

1. Open the file in full-screen view.
2. Press and hold the file name shown in the header.
3. Tap **Rename** from the menu that appears.
4. Type the new file name, then confirm.

metadata.title: Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > View media

text:
Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > Add media
You can add media two ways: choose an existing file from your device, or capture a new one with your camera.

1. Tap the **+** icon at the bottom right of the gallery. A menu opens with two options.
2. Tap **Gallery** to choose an existing photo or video, or tap **Camera** to capture a new one.
3. Select or capture the file. The media appears in the gallery immediately after upload.

Note:
  Photos or videos captured or uploaded while offline are queued. They sync to the gallery once your device reconnects to the internet.

metadata.title: Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > Add media

text:
Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > Filter media
Use the filter chips at the top of the gallery to narrow down the media displayed. You can apply the following filters:

| Filter | What it shows |
| :- | :- |
| **Media type** | Only photos, only videos, or all media |
| **Date** | Media uploaded on a specific date or within a custom date range |
| **Uploaded by** | Media uploaded by a specific team member |

Tap a filter chip to open its options, then tap the option you want. The gallery updates immediately. Tap the chip again to clear the filter.

metadata.title: Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > Filter media

text:
Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > Select multiple items
1. Tap **Select** at the top right of the gallery.
2. Tap each item you want to select. A checkmark appears on each selected item.
3. Use the bottom action bar to apply a bulk action to the selected items.

Remove media
Warning:
  Removing media from this gallery permanently deletes it. There is no Deleted items album and no restore option. This action cannot be undone.

**Remove a single item**

1. Tap the photo or video to open it in full-screen view.
2. Tap the **Remove** icon at the bottom of the screen.
3. Confirm the deletion when prompted.

**Remove multiple items**

1. Tap **Select** at the top right of the gallery.
2. Tap each item you want to remove.
3. Tap **Delete** from the bottom action bar.
4. Confirm the deletion when prompted.

metadata.title: Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > Select multiple items

text:
Customer/Contact Gallery on Mobile > FAQs
**Can I upload videos as well as photos?**

    Yes. You can upload both photos and videos from your device. You can also capture a new photo directly using the **Camera** option.

**What happens when I remove a photo?**

    Removing a photo from the customer or contact gallery permanently deletes it. Unlike the job gallery, there is no Deleted items album and no restore option.

**Can I filter media by the person who uploaded it?**

    Yes. Tap the **Uploaded by** filter chip at the top of the gallery and choose a team member's name to view only their uploads.

**Can I rename a photo after uploading it?**

    Yes. Open the photo in full-screen view, press and hold the file name in the header, then tap **Rename**.

**What if I uploaded a photo while offline?**

    Photos uploaded offline are queued on your device. They sync automatically once your device reconnects to the internet.

    If the issue continues, contact [Support](mailto:support@zuper.co).

**Is this gallery the same as the job gallery?**

    No. The customer or contact gallery stores media linked directly to a customer or contact record, while the job gallery stores media linked to a specific job. Photos removed from the customer or contact gallery are permanently deleted, but photos removed from the job gallery move to a Deleted items album and can be restored.

    If the issue continues, contact [Support](mailto:support@zuper.co).

text:
Agent anatomy > Name and description
> The parts every Zuper Sense agent has, what each one does, and how they work together.

Every agent in Zuper Sense is constructed using a standard set of structural components. Understanding how these components function helps you quickly identify where to adjust settings and customize agent behavior.

Name and description
The name and description say what the agent is for. They are what you and your colleagues see on the **My agents** card and at the top of the agent's page.  Write descriptions clearly so team members can easily identify which agent suits their operational needs.

metadata.title: Agent anatomy > Name and description

text:
Agent anatomy > Configuration and instructions
**Configuration** holds the settings specific to that agent, the cities a Weather Agent forecasts and the Google listing a Reputation Agent monitors. Required fields are marked with an asterisk (\*) and must be completed before deployment.

**Custom Instructions** sits in the same section and holds two things:

* The instructions Zuper sets, which describe the agent's job step by step and reference the tools it uses.
* Whatever you add, which tailors the output, tone, what to emphasise, and thresholds that matter to your business.

Note: **Note**: Custom instructions are optional. Marketplace agents function out of the box once all required configuration fields are completed.

metadata.title: Agent anatomy > Configuration and instructions

text:
Agent anatomy > Triggers
A trigger is what starts the agent. Most Marketplace agents ship with a **Scheduled** trigger: pick **Every hour**, **Every day**, **Every week**, **Every month**, **Weekdays** or **Custom**, set the time, and the agent runs on that cadence in the timezone shown. **Run now** runs the agent once, on demand, without touching the schedule; it is available once the agent is **Active**.

metadata.title: Agent anatomy > Triggers

text:
Agent anatomy > Knowledge and Skills
**Knowledge** is the set of [**Knowledge Base**](/Zuper_Sense/Agent_Studio/Knowledge_Base) entries the agent reads before it answers; your terminology, policies and calculation rules. Add entries with **Add knowledge** and remove them with **Remove**.

[**Skills**](/Zuper_Sense/Agent_Studio/Skills) are reusable instructions for a repeatable task that you hand to an agent instead of retyping them.

metadata.title: Agent anatomy > Knowledge and Skills

text:
Agent anatomy > Tools
Tools are what the agent can act with. **Get Weather** fetches a forecast, **Fetch Google Reviews** pulls new reviews, **Send Email** sends the digest, and **Send Message (Chat)** posts to a Zuper Chat channel. A tool that still needs setting up is flagged **(needs setup)** in the instructions, and **Configure** on the tool row is where you finish it.

Warning: Removing a tool takes away the ability it depends on. An agent whose **Send Message (Chat)** tool is removed stops posting to chat, even though its instructions still describe it.

metadata.title: Agent anatomy > Tools

text:
Agent anatomy > Marketplace agents versus custom agents *(Coming soon)*
| Component | Marketplace agent | Custom agent *(Coming soon)* |
| - | - | - |
| Name and description | Defined by Zuper | Fully customizable |
| Configuration | Fill in predefined Zuper fields | Custom schema |
| Instructions | Zuper's instructions + user additions | Built from scratch |
| Triggers | Managed or configurable schedule | Fully custom triggers |
| Knowledge | Link/unlink custom KB entries | Fully customizable |
| Skills | Preset agent skills | Fully customizable |
| Tools | Pre-bundled integration tools | Fully customizable |

text:
Knowledge Base > Add an entry
> Teach your Zuper Sense agents your terminology, policies and calculation rules.

Knowledge Base is where you teach your agents how your business actually works. Once an entry is published and linked to an agent, Zuper Sense applies it every time it answers a related question, instead of falling back on a generic definition.

Add an entry
1. Open **Sense** from the left navigation, then select **Agent Studio**.
2. Select the **Knowledge base** in the left panel.
3. Select **+ Add Knowledge** at the bottom of the list.
4. Choose **Write knowledge** to type context, policies or FAQs directly.
   1. Paste a link to have Sense crawl a webpage, or upload a file to add a PDF, doc or sheet.
   2. Whichever way you add it, Sense extracts the content and shows it as text in the knowledge editor. For a link, select Refresh to re-crawl the page and pull in any changes..
5. Enter your content, then give the entry a clear title.

Note: **Note**: Uploaded files are limited to 7 MB each. Use the **All**, **Docs** and **Links** filters above the list to find an entry later.

metadata.title: Knowledge Base > Add an entry

text:
Knowledge Base > Publish an entry
Select **Publish knowledge** when the entry is ready for agents to use. Until then, it stays a draft, and no agent reads it.

A good entry states the rule and the reasoning behind its edge cases. An entry called "Completed Job Definition" might say a job counts as completed only once its status is Closed and its final invoice is paid in full, then explain why insurance payouts and financing delays are handled that way.

Tip: **Tip**: Be specific about edge cases, not just the general rule. The "why it matters" context is what lets an agent apply a rule correctly rather than repeat it.

metadata.title: Knowledge Base > Publish an entry

text:
Knowledge Base > Link an entry to an agent > From the agent
You can link an entry from either side.

From the agent
1. Open the agent from **My agents**.
2. Go to its **Knowledge** section and select **Add knowledge**.
3. Toggle on the entries this agent should use, then select **Done**.
4. Select **Save changes**.

From the entry
1. Open the entry from the **Knowledge base**.
2. Select **Add agents** next to **Used by** at the top right.
3. Select **+ Add** beside each agent that should use it.

Note: **Note**: One entry can be linked to several agents, and one agent can use several entries. Updating an entry updates it for every agent it is linked to.

metadata.title: Knowledge Base > Link an entry to an agent > From the agent

text:
Knowledge Base > How agents use knowledge
Once an entry is published and linked, ask Sense a related question, and it applies your rule instead of guessing, and it names the entry it used.

Select a source to read the entry that shaped the answer.

Keep entries current
When your business rules or terminology change, edit the entry and publish it again so answers stay accurate. Editing an entry that is already linked takes effect for every agent using it, with nothing else to reconnect.

Warning: Deleting an entry removes it from every agent linked to it, and their answers go back to generic definitions from the next question onwards.

metadata.title: Knowledge Base > How agents use knowledge

text:
Agent Studio overview > What an agent is
> Hire built-in agents or build your own, and put them to work in Zuper Sense.

Agent Studio is where Zuper Sense's agents live. Some answer questions in chat, others run in the background and post to Zuper Chat or email. Pick one from the Marketplace, or build your own.

What an agent is
An agent is an automated, configured worker designed to handle specific tasks. Every agent consists of a standard set of core components, including its configuration, instructions, triggers, knowledge base, and tools. To learn more about how these components work, see [**Agent Anatomy**](/Zuper_Sense/Agent_Studio/Agent_Anatomy).

* Pre-built agents provided by Zuper that you can configure and deploy, such as the [CSR](/Zuper_Connect/CSR-Agent), [Weather](/Zuper_Sense/Marketplace_Agents/Weather_Agent) or [Reputation agent](/Zuper_Sense/Marketplace_Agents/Reputation_Agent).
* Fully custom agents built tailored to your unique operational processes ***→*** <Badge color="purple">Coming Soon</Badge>
* For example, the **Business Intelligence** agent is the one giving insights in your questions on Sense chat.

text:
Agent Studio overview > Agent status types
The status badge on any card under **My Agents** indicates its current operational state:

  <colgroup>
    <col width="107" />

    <col width="325" />
  </colgroup>

      Status
      Definition

      **Active**
      Deployed and actively monitoring or responding to configured triggers.

      **Draft**
      Configured but not yet deployed; does not execute on triggers.

      **Paused**

Note:

text:
Skills
Skills are reusable, invokable instructions that tell Sense or an agent exactly how to do a task: things like preparing a daily brief, summarizing a proposal for a homeowner, or checking which customers are overdue on payments. Instead of typing out the same detailed request every time, you just run the Skill, and Sense or an agent follows those instructions to do the task.

Skills are configured in Agent Studio, and can be run directly in Sense chat using a `/command`, or attached to an agent. Zuper provides a set of ready-to-use Skills out of the box, and you can also create your own.

metadata.title: Skills

text:
Skills > Skills available out of the box
Zuper provides these Skills by default:

* **Daily Brief**: A personalized daily overview of jobs, finance, proposals, and tasks, with key watchouts highlighted.
* **1:1 Meeting Prep**: A concise manager brief for a 1:1 with a specific rep, covering job performance, commissions, and call coaching.
* **Proposal Summary**: A plain-language homeowner summary of a proposal, ready to send by email or text.
* **Collections Risk Check**: A review of overdue invoice patterns for one customer or company-wide, flagging accounts that may need follow-up.
* **Profitability Recap Report**: A short explanation of how profitability moved for a period and what likely drove the change.
* **Quote Pipeline Health Report**: A weekly view of which open quotes are aging normally and which look stalled or at risk.

metadata.title: Skills > Skills available out of the box

text:
Skills > Create a custom Skill
You can create your own Skills to match how your team works.

1. Go to **Agent Studio > Skills**.
2. Select **New Skill**.
3. Give it a name. This becomes its slash command (for example, "Job Readiness Check").
4. Add a short description, and write the instructions for what the Skill should do.
5. **Save**. The Skill is now available to run.

Info:
  Skills you create are specific to your account. They won't appear for other Zuper customers, and other customers' Skills won't appear for you.

metadata.title: Skills > Create a custom Skill

text:
Skills > Attach a Skill to an agent
Skills can also be attached to a custom agents, so that agent knows how to do that specific task whenever it's relevant.

1. Open the custom agent in **Agent Studio**.
2. Go to its **Skills** section.
3. Select the Skill you want to attach from your available Skills.
4. Save the agent.

Once attached, the agent follows that Skill's instructions as part of how it responds, so you don't need to invoke the slash command separately for that agent to use it.

Note:
  **Note**: Skills can't be attached to Zuper-provided agents (like Weather Agent or Reputation Agent). If you want to customize how one of these agents behaves, add instructions directly to that agent instead.

metadata.title: Skills > Attach a Skill to an agent

text:
Skills > Run a Skill with a slash command
* Type `/` in the Sense chat input, on the home screen or inside a thread.
* A list of available Skills appears, each with its name and a short description.
* Keep typing to filter the list, or use the arrow keys to move through it.
* Select a Skill to insert it, then press enter to run it.

Info:
  If more information is needed to complete the Skill (for example, which customer, which time period, or which proposal), you'll be asked before the result is generated.

Note:
  **Note**: If more information is needed to complete the Skill (for example, which customer, which time period, or which proposal), you'll be asked before the result is generated.

text:
How answers work > Follow-up questions
> What you can do with a Zuper Sense answer: follow-ups, clarifications, pinning to a Radar, and the answer actions.

Every answer Zuper Sense gives you behaves the same way, whether you ask about your account data, why something happened, or how to do something in Zuper. This page covers what you can do with an answer once you have it.

Follow-up questions
Sense offers a **Suggested Follow-up** that dynamically predicts what you might want to ask next based on the conversation context.

1. Read the response, then select a question from the **Suggested follow-ups** above the message box.
2. To continue the conversation, choose a suggested question or enter your own.

Follow-up questions remain within the same thread, allowing Sense to retain the context of previous questions and responses. This helps you explore a topic further without having to repeat information.

metadata.title: How answers work > Follow-up questions

text:
How answers work > Clarifying questions
If Sense does not have sufficient context to answer accurately, it will ask one or more clarifying questions rather than guessing. Once you answer, Sense uses that additional context to provide an accurate response.

Select one of the options and click **Next**, or enter your answer in the message box instead.

Pin an answer to a Radar
Save time on recurring KPIs by pinning answers directly to a [**Radar**](/Zuper_Sense/Radar/Overview) rather than repeatedly asking Sense. Pinned cards update live, keeping important metrics visible for you and your team.

1. Click  next to **Add to Radar** below the answer to open **Choose a radar**.
2. Select every Radar where you want the card to appear, or click **New Radar** to create a new one (changes save automatically).
3. Close the selector once you are finished.

Selecting **Add to Radar** immediately pins the answer in one click and opens the picker so you can add it to additional boards:

* **In a standard thread:** Pins directly to **My Radar**.
* **In a board-initiated thread (via + Add KPI):** Pins directly to that specific board.

Once pinned, the button changes to **View in Radar**, which takes you directly to the card on its board when selected.

metadata.title: How answers work > Clarifying questions

text:
How answers work > Actions on an answer
Use the actions located in the bottom-right corner of any answer card to manage or refine responses:

* **Copy**: Copy the answer.
* **Rerun**: Re-ask the same question and get a new response.
* **Thumbs up / down:** Submit feedback on the response to help us improve Sense over time.

Check the sources
When an answer relies on your [**Knowledge Base**](/Zuper_Sense/Agent_Studio/Knowledge_Base) or on Zuper's help documentation, the underlying materials are listed under Sources. Click any source to view the original entry or article. Always check Sources or drill into a Radar card to verify numbers before acting on them.

metadata.title: How answers work > Actions on an answer

What can I ask Sense

text:

Sense reviews the relevant data in your Zuper account and automatically chooses the best format to present the answer. Depending on your question, the result may appear as a KPI, table, chart, scorecard, or written summary.

Every answer includes the same set of actions, such as asking follow-up questions, pinning the result to a Radar, copying the response, rerunning the query, or providing feedback. Learn more in [**How Answers Work**](/Zuper_Sense/Ask_Sense/How_Answers_Work).

text:

You can also attach a hand-drawn sketch of the chart or KPI you're picturing. Sense interprets the sketch and recreates it using data from your Zuper account.

Sense analyzes the sketch and generates the requested visualization using your business data.
